## Highlights

The bundled CLI 0.23.0 includes two fixes requested in #11022:

- Managed memory availability now respects the `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` setting (#6941). Hosts that disable managed auto memory no longer see remember/dream requests admitted or managed-memory instructions in the system prompt; local patches can be removed.
- Size-triggered microcompaction now clears old tool results toward a low watermark (#8464), so it no longer rewrites another part of the conversation prefix on every subsequent turn. Provider prompt-cache reuse is preserved across long tool-heavy sessions, reducing cached-input cost.

You artifacts are now verified!

releases.title: Release v0.27.0
releases.body:
<!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 -->

## Highlights

- Managed-agent sessions can hold multiple child questions at once, answer them in any order, and keep drafts and errors separated per child. ([#16484](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16484))
- Web Shell adds a task Q&A heatmap and an Ask for details side task that explains pending Ask User Question options without answering. ([#16037](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16037), [#16458](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16458))
- GitHub channel editor adds Repository Filter allowlists and blocklists, while bound PR delivery and plain comment delivery become more reliable. ([#16493](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16493), [#16502](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16502), [#16416](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16416))
- Shell tool edits now handle CRLF and Unicode safely in sed substitutions, and cancelled commands report as interrupted while keeping partial output. ([#15701](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15701), [#15836](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15836))
- Managed-agent runtime is faster and less prone to deadlocks, with safer session rename, snapshot publication, storage admission, and lock handling. ([#16480](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16480), [#16478](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16478), [#16376](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16376), [#16489](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16489), [#16447](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16447))
- Upgrade refusals and Advisor startup errors no longer expose embedded credentials, and empty Harness user info is rejected during start and verify. ([#16352](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16352), [#16083](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16083))

## Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

## Complete Change List

### Features

- Added FileChanged hooks for local non-managed sessions, reporting add, change, and unlink events for watched files and directories. ([#13969](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13969)) by @samuelhsin
- CI Failure Patrol now posts visible bilingual notices when it reruns flaky failures or cannot classify them, improving PR feedback. ([#16459](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16459)) by @wenshao
- feat(cli): align managed agent basic tools with daemon ([#16445](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16445)) by @doudouOUC
- Moves Web Shell session search into the sidebar top row beside View activity and improves narrow-layout behavior. ([#16467](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16467)) by @wenshao
- Improves CI triage security by isolating triage agent credentials and routing all triage runs to ECS. ([#16468](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16468)) by @wenshao
- Managed-agent sessions can now keep multiple child questions pending, answer child questions in any order, and keep drafts and errors separated per child. ([#16484](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16484)) by @doudouOUC
- With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, Ink TUI turns send the continuation round after tool batches and handle queued input and retries. ([#16428](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16428)) by @qqqys
- Web Shell composer now offers a task Q&A activity heatmap; clicking a day scrolls the transcript to that day's first Q&A and highlights it. ([#16037](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16037)) by @samuelhsin
- Adds a Repository Filter to the GitHub channel editor with allowlist and blocklist modes, URL-friendly entries, and skipped-notification timeline rows. ([#16493](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16493)) by @wenshao
- Adds an Ask for details action to pending Ask User Question panels in Web Shell, opening a side task that explains options without answering. ([#16458](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16458)) by @wenshao
- Reclaims idle channel sessions in serve so cached channel routes no longer exhaust the maxSessions budget.

releases.title: v2.2.6
releases.body:
### Highlights

- **Shared MCP Connections**: Turn on pooling for an MCP server to share one connection across projects with the same setup, so you run fewer processes and start faster. ([#61185](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61185))
- **GUI Plugin Themes and New Slots**: GUI plugins can now add color themes, render or add actions to code blocks, and use native settings and menu components. ([#61485](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61485), [#61533](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61533), [#61527](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61527), [#61509](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61509))
- **Mobile Composer Dock**: On phones and tablets, composer actions now sit in a touch dock above the keyboard with larger buttons. ([#61773](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61773))
- **Scripted Runs in Worktrees**: Run `opencode run -w` to start the session in a new git worktree, or `--worktree=<name>` to name it. ([#60712](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60712))
- **Automatically Archived Runs**: Add `--archived` to `opencode run` to keep scripted and CI sessions out of your inbox and session lists. ([#61270](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61270))

### Core

#### Improvements

- Added opt-in MCP connection sharing through `pool: true`. ([#61185](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61185))
- Added `opencode run --archived`, which creates the session already archived so scripted and CI runs stay out of the inbox, home, and session lists. Archived sessions are also hidden from the TUI session list and skipped by `--continue`. ([#61270](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61270))
- Added `opencode run --worktree` (`-w`), which starts the session in a new git worktree. Use `--worktree=<name>` to choose the worktree name. It cannot be combined with `--continue` or `--session`. ([#60712](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60712))
- Added provider- and model-specific session warming settings, including an `interval: "auto"` mode based on cache TTL. ([#60025](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60025), [#60969](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60969))
- Added the `websearch.use` policy action and switches for enabling all feature flags with `OPENCODE_FLAGS=all` or `experimental.all_flags`. ([#61557](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61557), [#61826](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61826))
- Added an experimental bytecode VM for Code Mode. It is off by default; turn it on with `experimental.codemode_vm: true` or `OPENCODE_FLAGS=codemode_vm`. ([#62358](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/62358))
- Added support for Microsoft Store installations of PowerShell 7 on Windows. ([#61952](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61952))
- Added Azure Messages support for Foundry Claude models. ([#60934](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60934))

#### Bug fixes

- `opencode run` now waits for the background shell commands, subagents, and image jobs that its prompt started, then lets the model respond to their results before it exits. While it waits, it prints `waiting for N background job(s)` (a `background_wait` event with `--format json`). There is no time limit: a job that never exits, such as a dev server or file watcher, keeps the run open until you press Ctrl+C or send SIGTERM, so set a timeout on CI jobs. ([#60699](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60699), [#61911](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61911))
- Reworked noninteractive `opencode run` execution so arguments, cancellation, compiled WebSocket upgrades, and service shutdown complete reliably. SIGTERM now cancels the session and its background jobs and exits with code 143. ([#61911](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61911), [#61721](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61721), [#61518](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61518), [#61564](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/61564))
- Serve

releases.title: v2.1.319
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier; set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` to keep using it (Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged)
- Changed auto mode behind an LLM gateway: `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` turns on the server-side check even with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` set; if managed settings set the latter, they must set the `1` too
- Added support for MCP tasks in the terminal: when an MCP server runs a tool call as a task, Claude Code moves it to the background right away and tells Claude the result when it finishes
- Added the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASK_BACKGROUND` environment variable to make Claude Code wait for an MCP task inside its tool call instead of moving it to the background right away
- Added `permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting` setting: a tool call that would wait on a permission prompt is denied and the turn continues, in terminal sessions, subagents and teammates
- Added `/claude-api latency-optimize` to find where your Claude API code makes people wait and try faster settings against your eval
- Added the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEATURE_FLAGS` environment variable, which stops feature-flag fetching without turning off telemetry; every flag then uses its built-in default
- Added spend for today, this week and this month to `/usage` for developers behind a Claude apps gateway who have no spend limit, when the gateway runs this version or later
- Added `admin.pooled_conflict_rule` and `admin.pooled_priority_order` to the Claude apps gateway, to set which pooled group budget pays first for a developer in several groups
- Added an optional `login_notice` setting to the Claude apps gateway that shows an operator-defined message on the gateway's browser verification page and on Claude Code's sign-in screen
- Added `CLAUDE_GATEWAY_LOG_FORMAT=json` to the Claude apps gateway: operational log lines become JSON with `severity`, `time` and `message`, for log collectors that read the level from a field
- Added a Claude apps gateway boot warning for a case where another policy's `availableModels` also allows a custom model id that one policy lists by name
- Added start-up warnings to the Claude apps gateway for policies with no `desktopHome` that rely on `coworkTabEnabled: false` or `chatSessionRetentionDays`, ahead of Claude Desktop's November 10 change
- Added a warning when your claude.ai login ends and Claude Code continues on the sign-in from `ant auth login`, which bills usage to your Claude Console organization
- Added a line at startup naming the Claude Console organization that is billed in a case where Claude Code uses the sign-in from `ant auth login`

releases.title: Release v0.26.9
releases.body:
<!-- qwen-release-notes:v2 -->

## Highlights

_See the complete change list below._

## Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

## Skill installation and activation

Skill ZIP uploads, daemon APIs, TypeScript SDK support, bulk activation, and recovery protections make installing and managing Skills more reliable.

- Adds PUT /skills/activation and setUserSkillsActivation to enable or disable 1-100 user Skills in one request, with saved preferences and propagation status. ([#16186](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16186))
- Prepares Skill installation for larger archives by adding disk-based ZIP handling and recovery-backup protection to the installer. ([#16421](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16421))
- Adds daemon API routes for installing large Skill ZIPs by upload or host file path and querying installation receipts after failures. ([#16422](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16422))
- Adds TypeScript SDK support for installing Skill ZIPs from File, Blob, bytes, or host path, with attempt IDs and receipt lookup. ([#16423](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16423))
- WebShell can now upload Skill ZIP archives from the Skills page, show daemon limits, and check uncertain installation results. ([#16424](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16424))

## Web Shell sessions and composer

Web Shell session titles, Add menu polish, draft preservation, batch deletion, and listSessions pagination fixes improve everyday session management.

- Keeps Web Shell sidebar session titles visible when a transcript is rebuilt, preventing session names from disappearing. ([#16299](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16299))
- Polishes the Web Shell composer Add menu with consistent icons, labels, descriptions, spacing, and improved accessibility for actions and Plan state. ([#16181](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16181))
  ![Main menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/d37bb0579f3c6b212c2a18d76acc59af920279fb/composer-menu-16155/before-dark.png)
  ![Updated production-package menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/d37bb0579f3c6b212c2a18d76acc59af920279fb/composer-menu-16155/after-dark.png)
- WebShell now preserves unsent drafts when ArrowUp or ArrowDown moves through wrapped prompt lines before history navigation. ([#14909](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14909))
- web-shell: batch session deletions at the route limit ([#14637](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14637))
  ![Before bulk deletion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jianyx1/qwen-code/82199691bd3c0e8908df82bbaf5d38a98fb44143/before.png)
  ![After bulk deletion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jianyx1/qwen-code/82199691bd3c0e8908df82bbaf5d38a98fb44143/after.png)
- listSessions pagination no longer skips sessions when multiple session files share the same modification time. ([#16024](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16024))

## Managed agents and sessions

Managed agent automation, durable questions, activation renewals, writer recovery, and history caching improve hosted session reliability and speed.

- managed-agent: support durable structured user questions ([#16433](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16433))
- managed-agent: enable automation by default ([#16448](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16448))
- Managed agent activation renewals now locate the activation lease more efficiently, reducing renewal lookup overhead. ([#16336](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16336))
- Improves managed-agent performance by removing tenant guard locks from native journal snapshot publication. ([#16410](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16410))
- Managed Session history rebuilds now cache message bodies per process, reducing repeated reads and improving performance for hosted turns. ([#16337](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16337))
- HTTP Managed Session writer recovery now keeps a live in-flight renewal grant instead of unnecessarily re-acquirin

### macOS install note

The app isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID yet, so macOS may call a
downloaded build *"damaged"* — it's Gatekeeper quarantine, not a bad file.
After moving the app to Applications, clear the flag once, then open normally:

```sh
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/OpenHands Agent Canvas.app"
```

Signing + notarization is tracked in OpenHands/OpenHands#16774.

## New Features

- Open the agent command center with `codex agents --no-daemon`. The command center and session picker now mark unread results (#58238, #58239, #58263, #58264).
- Switch between connected backends from the terminal session picker and keep your drafts when switching (#58280, #58457).
- Preview local image attachments while composing on supported terminals, and open viewed local images from clickable transcript paths (#58261, #58446).
- Find API key and cloud provider options under “Sign in another way.” Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to set up Google Cloud Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials or a credential file (#57857, #58427).
- Opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings from `/experimental` (#58157).
- Expand patch details directly in the transcript while an approval prompt is open (#58281).

## Bug Fixes

- Saved chats stay visible after you switch model providers. If a chat can’t resume, you can read its transcript and prepare an editable prompt to continue in a new chat (#58202).
- `Ctrl+L` clears the terminal display while keeping earlier messages available through `Ctrl+T` (#58266).
- Deleting text that exposes a leading `!` keeps an ordinary draft in chat mode (#58412).
- Network approval prompts close when their requests end. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint prompt one at a time (#58350, #58351).
- Long realtime V3 conversations save completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows (#58221).
- Automatic context compaction now accounts for retained output from failed responses and responses with missing token usage data (#58404).

## Documentation

- The app-server README covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` and `prompt-user` command rules that require fresh human approval (#58045, #58182).
- The `openai-docs` skill recommends the documented replacement when migrating away from a deprecated model (#58134).

## Chores

- DotSlash manifests now reference the Cargo packages shipped with the release (#58717, #58757).
- Linux musl builds use fewer allocator arenas to reduce idle memory after conversations unload (#58399).

# Subagents, Sysadmin Mode, and PGP/SSH Prompts This is a big one! Crush can now run a team of subagents, permissions are much more flexible, and you can now do GPG and SSH auth right inside Crush! Read on for more. ## 👩🏼‍🐰‍👩🏽 Subagents At last, subagents. Crush can now spawn a little team of friendly subagents in the background, as well as check on them, send them mid-run follow-ups, stop them, or move them to a different model.

You can watch them work right in the transcript, sidebar and header. Every subagent gets its own name, too, so you always know who's doing what. And, if you refer to them by name, Crush will know which of ’em you’re talking about! ## 🚨 Sysadmin Mode Ever wish Crush could `DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE;`? Now it can, with Sysadmin mode! In fact, in Sysadmin mode, Crush can run any command on your system. Be careful.

Find Sysadmin mode in the command palette (ctrl+p) or toggle through all modes with shift+tab. ## 🙅🏻‍♀️ Safe Commands Of course, Yolo Mode still blocks dangerous commands, but now which commands are dangerous is up to you. * `permissions safe` marks commands safe for yolo * `permissions block` blocks commands completely * `permissions unblock` unblocks restricted commands ```bash # Building is fine permissions safe "go build" "cargo check" # Don't touch my infra please permissions block kubectl terraform # Curl your heart out permissions unblock curl ``` ## 🗝️ PGP and SSH It’s so annoying when you’re using an AI agent and can’t enter an SSH password, activate your Yubikey and enter GPG passwords, eh? Well, with Crush, that annoyance is a thing of the past. No more compromising your security to when usin’ AI! --- There’s tons more stuff in the changelog below, too. This is one of our biggest releases, and we're _so_ grateful for your support! Have a great day, The Charm Team ⭐ --- ## Changelog ### New! * 965d1a794bbe5c01c2f0e5b62293791060d81622: feat(agent): dispatch detached sub-agents and message them mid-run (@taciturnaxolotl) * 938fef205ca1ba6a35d5ff9f93e69b5c31d41a83: feat(agent): let agent_send move a subagent to a different model (@taciturnaxolotl) * f7179d1624643b84fb350528c85d86407541ac6e: feat(bash): judge a chain of read-only commands by its parts (@taciturnaxolotl) * 46c7bc4a65a2c3553b35eed7e4916871e9df3760: feat(config): let a project configure the commands it runs all day (@taciturnaxolotl) * 4efcd2c345fe9b7d5462d73bfd6e40dde379c731: feat(message): carry a sub-agent report as its own message part (@taciturnaxolotl) * 44cb8e3a8aeb6d555ce9de3886c3efdd76ef01b5: feat(permissions): add sysadmin mode (@taciturnaxolotl) * 526da24eceeba1ab4516d2da7d0ccf6faf96636c: feat(permissions): make the dangerous-command list configurable (@taciturnaxolotl) * c42442d94b304a64ca208d819dee9894188815bf: feat(permissions): stop asking about dangerous commands in yolo mode (@taciturnaxolotl) * d4430bcce9c80d0f71f1a96dba921db85110bac4: feat(subagents): give each subagent its name for real, not just on screen (@taciturnaxolotl) * d11509b7899a720852899afc55211088aa4c1272: feat(subagents): shuffle first names, accent them, and set them apart on screen (@taciturnaxolotl) * c55f231c328a047a1710574ab32d677e368a87de: feat(ui): calmer subagent messages and a readable status (@taciturnaxolotl) * e498ee2a4557623594ccc837b3678c97a2994639: feat(ui): make a dangerous permission prompt harder to approve by reflex (@taciturnaxolotl) * 573e1fb2442d7ae41fdd75ff147e34a8c981f1a6: feat(ui): name subagent actions for what they do (@tacitur

## Highlights

The bundled CLI 0.23.0 includes two fixes requested in #11022:

- Managed memory availability now respects the `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` setting (#6941). Hosts that disable managed auto memory no longer see remember/dream requests admitted or managed-memory instructions in the system prompt; local patches can be removed.
- Size-triggered microcompaction now clears old tool results toward a low watermark (#8464), so it no longer rewrites another part of the conversation prefix on every subsequent turn. Provider prompt-cache reuse is preserved across long tool-heavy sessions, reducing cached-input cost.

## Complete Change List

### Features

- Adds an operator-scoped model.catalogRefresh setting and lets privacy.usageStatisticsEnabled: false stop background catalog refreshes while local metadata remains available. ([#16066](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16066)) by @yiliang114
- feat(managed-agent): support full model configuration at session creation ([#16153](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16153)) by @doudouOUC
- When experimental.unifiedAgentLoop is enabled, ACP Goal turns run on the shared agent loop with shared rounds, tool batches, and stop points. ([#16131](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16131)) by @qqqys
- Adds a Channel events page to Web Shell with a filterable, auto-refreshing timeline of Channel activity, skip reasons, replies, task transitions, and poll results. ([#16106](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16106)) by @wenshao
- Adds a local /verify-pr Docker recipe that runs untrusted PR code in a container while keeping model credentials on the host through a chat-completion proxy. ([#16077](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16077)) by @wenshao
- Runs Mods prompt.submit hooks in the Ink terminal before typed prompts are processed, allowing hooks to see composer text with pasted content expanded. ([#16180](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16180)) by @qqqys
- Adds a managed Web Shell host entry, improves managed empty-state layout, and consolidates session-failure and unconfirmed-submission notices above the composer. ([#15928](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15928)) by @yiliang114
- Adds Settings → Connections → Allow remote connections to qwen serve, enabling remote access, token use, and client disconnects without restarting. ([#15887](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15887)) by @yiliang114
- With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, ACP cron and background-notification turns now use the shared agent loop for consistent rounds, tool batching, and stopping. ([#16190](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16190)) by @qqqys
- Workspace uploads can now proceed concurrently while still rejecting occupied destinations and preserving directory occupancy protections. ([#16212](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16212)) by @doudouOUC
- GitHub events for bound PRs now go to the associated session as untrusted prompts, and replies stay private unless published. ([#16117](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16117)) by @wenshao

- Pins the RHEL 10 EPEL bootstrap RPM and makes desktop smoke teardown treat Linux zombie processes as stopped while still reporting live daemon failures. ([#16154](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16154)) by @yiliang114

- Fixes PR review endpoint routing by selecting the cohort before the model and reports the final bucket, cohort, model, and endpoint hostname. ([#16151](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16151)) by @yiliang114
- fix(serve): keep record_artifact guidance out of Managed Runtime worker results ([#16148](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16148)) by @wenshao

releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added a record of your answer when Claude Code asks to turn on the mods it writes in a session
- Added `assume_role` on `mantle` upstreams of the Claude apps gateway, for a role in another AWS account and for per-developer AWS cost attribution
- Added an `effort` option to a mod's `$.model.fork`, so a quick side job can run at `low` whatever effort the session uses; the result reports the effort sent
- Added the date a stored claude.ai sign-in ends to `claude auth status` (`loginExpiresAt`) and to `claude -p` JSON results (`credential_expires_at`)
- Added a one-line stderr warning to `claude -p` text output, starting 10 days before a stored claude.ai sign-in ends
- Fixed `--continue` sometimes losing the earlier conversation after a malformed tool call's retries ran out (regression in 2.1.314)
- Fixed macOS sessions with many running Bash commands stalling while memory grew
- Fixed permission prompts being answered by keys typed just after sending a message, or before a slow prompt appeared
- Fixed `/logout`, `claude auth logout` and `claude mcp remove` reporting success, and changes to trust, consent or MCP settings being dropped with no word, when the config file could not be updated on a shared network home directory
- Fixed jobs exiting with `Not logged in` when another terminal or host signs in again to the same account and organization on the same home
- Fixed `claude mcp add` and `remove` writing the config without its lock: they now wait for it or exit 1, though another job's save can still replace a saved server
- Fixed `claude plugin` commands exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run
- Fixed `claude plugin validate` passing a custom-named marketplace file that `claude plugin marketplace add` rejects
- Fixed stdio MCP servers that exit on the version probe being re-probed on every start; a server that dies in under 3s for its own reason is also pinned to the legacy handshake for 7 days
- Fixed sessions being refused at startup by an `allowedProviders` list that another login on the same machine had stored
- Fixed idle compaction replacing a conversation with a reply that was not a summary
- Fixed the "Now using usage credits" notice reappearing about every 30 seconds while a background subagent is running
- Fixed custom slash commands that fail, or that only Claude can invoke, printing nothing in `claude -p` and SDK sessions
- Fixed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions reporting success when an API error cut off a reply while a mod hooked `turn.step`
- Fixed a message sent right after a model change still running after Stop in headless sessions: Stop now cancels or stops it as it would a queued message
- Fixed a deleted session transcript being re-created with its last prompt when an idle non-interactive session exited
- Fixed `claude remote-control` hosts, the background daemon and self-hosted runners failing to start new sessions (`spawn ENOENT`) after an update or version cleanup removed the binary of a still-running process
- Fixed a running Claude Code process owned by another user (for example one left by `sudo claude`) being treated as dead by version cleanup, which could delete its binary
- Fixed `/remote-control` showing a session as available after a failed connection
- Fixed `/design revoke` reporting success when the request failed with a 404
- Fixed a shell command approved after a self-hosted runner or cloud session restart running in the session's start folder, not the folder it was asked in; if that folder can't be entered, it is not run
- Fixed Claude not being told when an approved connector tool was unavailable after a cloud session restart
- Fixed cloud sessions being stopped in the middle of a turn when the service refuses uploads for several minutes
- Fixed variables a `Setup` hook writes to `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` not reaching the Bash tool in some cloud sessions
- Fixed the iPhone app showing a cloud session's turn as finished while it

releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added a warning to `/schedule` when a new cloud scheduled task gets connectors you did not ask for, with how to remove them
- Added a check that asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address to the network
- Added `onFailure: "block"` for Agent SDK hook callbacks, so a callback that fails blocks the action instead of letting it run
- Added a notice in Claude Desktop's Code tab when your organization's remote managed settings haven't loaded for the session, and another once they do
- Added a notice when auto mode's check has no answer for a subagent's tool call, which used to leave nothing in the main view
- Added `anthropic.plan`, `anthropic.seat_type`, `anthropic.provider` and `anthropic.custom_base_url` to OTel metrics, events and spans
- Added a cost report to the Claude apps gateway admin API, `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost`, for reading past spend over a date range in total, per developer, per day or per IdP group
- Added a daily record of each developer's IdP groups on Claude apps gateways with `admin:` set, kept for `admin.identity_retention_days`, which the cost report groups by
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID`: set it to `1` on a self-hosted runner to have `claude -p` run inside a session use that session's ID and transcript, as in earlier versions
- Fixed project and local MCP servers disconnecting after the first turn in some Claude desktop sessions
- Fixed auto mode failing every turn when an LLM gateway set as the base URL answers 403 or 422 to its server-side safety check (a 403 with an apiKeyHelper is unchanged)
- Fixed `claude auth status` exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run
- Fixed a project's `effortLevel` setting being ignored by sessions that an app starts ahead of time and then opens in the project, such as new sessions in the desktop app's Code tab
- Fixed `claude --from-pr` reporting "No conversations found" in projects with many sessions when the linked session was older than the first page
- Fixed the second of two simultaneous permission prompts showing no file path or command on claude.ai and the mobile apps
- Fixed Remote Control and SDK hosts offering "don't ask again" on a mod's tool calls
- Fixed session titles being lost in cloud and SDK sessions when a new message or Stop arrived while the title was generating
- Fixed self-paced `/loop` wakeups sometimes not being scheduled when Claude left a field out of its request
- Fixed auto mode in cloud sessions stopping for approval when the Artifact tool uploaded, wrote to a database or saved a file through the outputs folder
- Fixed skills synced from claude.ai being lost or downloaded again every ten minutes when they can't be written to disk
- Fixed `/schedule` leaving a cloud scheduled task's next run time and link out of its results after creating or updating it
- Fixed screen readers speaking a running subagent's elapsed time and token count on every change in screen reader mode
- Fixed a region or network block (HTTP 403) being shown as a sign-in failure; the error now explains the block
- Fixed Claude saying a working claude.ai connector needed authorization or had failed in cloud sessions when a synced plugin included the same server
- Fixed `claude -p` exiting 0 when a full disk or quota lost its transcript or ~/.claude.json writes; it now prints an error and, in text and json output, exits 1. Full NFS exports may be missed
- Fixed edits to settings files made in the first second or so after launch not taking effect until a settings file changed again
- Fixed old transcripts not being cleaned up on machines where some runs skip cleanup, such as runs using `--setting-sources`
- Fixed deleted agent team inboxes being re-created by a teammate's late message
- Fixed a re-created agent teammate being removed from its team by an earlier shutdown approval
- Fixed stored scheduled tasks being impossible to list or delete after schedu

releases.title: Release v0.26.6
releases.body:
<!-- qwen-release-notes:v1 -->

## Highlights

_See the complete change list below._

## Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

## Complete Change List

### Features

- Adds a Web Shell sidebar activity view for trusted workspace conversations, showing approval/input/error states, unread completions, running work, and bulk read/archive controls. ([#16022](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16022)) by @deggs7
- Adds an "Add to Split View" option to eligible sidebar session menus in web shell, making it easier to open sessions side by side. ([#15956](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15956)) by @4ekuct25
- Adds request success rate, output speed, per-model success indicators, and distinct model colors to the Web Shell token usage panel. ([#16108](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16108)) by @qqqys
- Web Shell composer shows a dismissible Workflow chip that turns Workflow mode off, warns when tools are unavailable, and summarizes the mode in the + menu. ([#16107](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16107)) by @qqqys
- Web Shell Token Usage now plots per-request output speed, first-token latency, and failure details by model, making session performance and errors easier to inspect. ([#16111](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16111)) by @qqqys
- With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop enabled, more ACP turns, including channel prompts and Goal-proposal approvals, run on the shared loop. ([#15902](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15902)) by @qqqys
- Mods can now run prompt.submit hooks in headless runs for -p prompts and stream-json user messages, allowing prompt inspection or rewriting before submission. ([#15905](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15905)) by @qqqys
- Desktop releases now publish Fedora 44 and RHEL 10 x64 RPM installers alongside existing Linux packages. ([#16060](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16060)) by @yiliang114
- feat(web-shell): make GitHub channel configuration usable ([#16096](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16096)) by @wenshao
- feat(verify-pr): inherit --publish consent on same-session re-verification ([#16112](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16112)) by @wenshao
- feat(ci): let the PR review canary cohort carry its own endpoint ([#16130](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16130)) by @yiliang114

### Bug Fixes

- OAuth refresh lock cleanup now removes the lock only when the current process owns it, preventing exiting processes from deleting active refresh locks. ([#15661](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15661)) by @2SinceJuly
- MCP tool discovery now skips duplicate tool names but keeps all uniquely named tools, preventing one name collision from hiding an entire server's tools. ([#15757](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15757)) by @2SinceJuly
- The Web Shell Plugins page now shows a back control when the navigation rail is unavailable, letting users return to chat from compact layouts. ([#15651](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15651)) by @2SinceJuly
- LSP code-navigation queries now fail with an explicit reason when no language server is ready instead of returning empty results. ([#15946](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15946)) by @404khai
- The verify report now counts targeted gate test-suite results separately from a round's scripted assertions, making assertion totals reflect only round checks. ([#16013](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16013)) by @wenshao
- Makes long /btw answers scroll in a bounded panel with mouse wheel, Shift+Up/Down, PageUp/PageDown, and a scrollbar, while short answers remain unchanged. ([#15982](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15982)) by @2SinceJuly
- Fixes verify-pr to count each suite run as one assertion and handle skip notices on closed PRs so review rounds are not rejected with zero assertions. ([#16050](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16050)) by @wenshao
- Fixes Kimi K3 generation recognition so supported IDs use the 1,000,000-to

releases.title: v1.5.0
releases.body:
### New Features

- **Extension update changelogs**: see what changed in installed extension packages on the next fresh launch after an update. Package authors can choose the changelog path, and `collapseChangelog` condenses the notices. See [Show a changelog](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/packages.md#show-a-changelog).
- **Faster streaming**: large tool calls are parsed incrementally, and code-heavy answers and tool rows reuse highlighting and rendered Markdown instead of repeating the work on every update. See [Keep rendering responsive](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/tui.md#keep-rendering-responsive).
- **Custom self-update commands**: use `PI_SELF_UPDATE_COMMAND` or `selfUpdateCommand` to update pi through a wrapper or another package manager. See [Custom update command](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/cli.md#custom-update-command).
- **GPT-6.1 Terra**: available through OpenAI, Azure OpenAI Responses, and OpenAI Codex, with tool search, mid-conversation thinking-level changes, and thinking `off`. Codex offers a 500K context window. See [Models](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/cli.md#models).

### Breaking Changes

- Tool argument validation runs on `@earendil-works/pi-schema`. TypeBox features outside JSON Schema (`Type.Refine()`, `Type.BigInt()`, `Type.Undefined()`, codecs, `Format.Set()` formats) no longer apply to tool arguments; see [Tool parameter schemas and TypeBox](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/extensions.md#tool-parameter-schemas-and-typebox). Plain JSON Schema tools, including MCP tools, now get the same coercion as TypeBox tools, such as converting numeric strings and wrapping a single value into an array. Validation failures the model sees list pi-schema's messages (`- path: missing`, `- limit: expected number, got string`) instead of TypeBox's (`must have required properties path`, `must be number`).

### Added

- Extension packages can now show their changelog after an update. Pi reads `pi.changelogPath` from the package's `package.json`, or `CHANGELOG.md` in the package root, and on the next fresh launch shows entries newer than the last seen version under "Extension Updates". The `collapseChangelog` setting condenses this to one line per package ([#5958](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5958), [#8790](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/8790))
- `pi.exec()` accepts a `maxBuffer` option that limits stdout and stderr combined, and its result has a `truncated` field that is true when output exceeded the limit ([#11360](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11360))
- Device-code login (for example GitHub Copilot) now opens the verification page and copies the code when you press Enter. Providers can turn either action off with `openBrowserOnConfirm: false` or `copyCodeOnConfirm: false` ([#9282](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9282), [#9301](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9301))
- `pi update` can update Pi through a wrapper or another package manager. Set `PI_SELF_UPDATE_COMMAND` (for example `mise use -g npm:{packageName}@{version}`) or the global `selfUpdateCommand` setting; `pi update` runs it when pi.dev reports a newer release and fills `{packageName}`, `{version}`, and `{installSpec}` from that release. See [Custom update command](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.5.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/cli.md#custom-update-command) ([#7756](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/7756), [#5607](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5607))
- Extensions can format the user's configured keybindings with `keyText()` and `keyHint()` from the tool render context and the message and entry renderer options. Importing these functions from `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` can resolve the extension's own copy of the package, which does

releases.title: v2.1.316
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off
- Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with `pooled_budget` on the spend limits admin API
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
- Added `managed.policy_mode: layered` to the Claude apps gateway: every policy that matches a developer applies, each merged over the ones listed below it, not only the first
- Added `guardrail.input_tagging` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, which wraps prompts in the input tags that an Amazon Bedrock guardrail's prompt attacks filter needs; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt
- Deprecated fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026. After removal, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8. Migrate to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup
- Fixed shell commands being left running on macOS and Linux when Claude Code exits by itself, for example when credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived
- Fixed bash aliases with line breaks in their value (except in Git Bash), and functions whose names start with a dash, being garbled or lost in the Bash tool's shell
- Fixed bash scripts started from the Bash tool stopping after their first command when `SHELLOPTS` is exported
- Fixed PowerShell hooks not blocking on exit code 2 when the command begins with a type cast, `param`, `using` or an attribute
- Fixed some network requests hanging when a compressed response was cut off or corrupted
- Fixed `sonnet`, `opus` and `haiku` on Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock showing an error mid-session instead of switching to an older model when the newest is not yet available to the account or region
- Fixed the Claude apps gateway not checking every model a request names against `availableModels`, `deniedModels` and `models`; a request that names a blocked model now gets a 400 naming the field
- Fixed `claude auth login` refusing to run where managed settings require a Claude apps gateway; in a terminal it now shows the gateway sign-in
- Fixed `--restricted` sessions uploading files from outside the working directories when a Read allow rule covered them
- Fixed prompts containing invisible characters needing a second Enter to send; plain prompts now send cleaned on the first Enter, and commands still wait for review
- Fixed sub-agents that inherited a parent sub-agent's model moving to the main model when a background job or message woke them
- Fixed a managed `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` getting the built-in exceptions back from a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`
- Fixed cloud sessions and cloud scheduled tasks not being marked as failed when auto mode stopped a turn because the server returned no safety verdict
- Fixed `claude -p` text output sometimes not saying why auto mode stopped a turn when a background agent was still running
- Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` being ignored in sessions started by a host application (such as Claude Desktop) behind a proxy or LLM gateway with experimental betas turned off
- Fixed plugin MCP `headersHelper` scripts receiving a corrupted `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL when a credential-named environment variable was set to a switch value such as `1`
- Fixed the SDK `register_repo_root` control request not loading the CLAUDE.md of a directory outside the working directory (with `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`)
- Fixed the Artifact tool showing `?` for artifact database access rules at the `self` level, and not q

releases.title: v2.2.5
releases.body:
### Highlights

- **Worktree and Shell Mode Shortcuts**: Press `⌘⌥O` on macOS or `Ctrl+Alt+O` on Windows and Linux to choose a worktree, and `⌘⌥B` or `Ctrl+Alt+B` to choose its base branch. `⌘⇧X` or `Ctrl+Shift+X` now toggles shell mode in the composer. ([#60713](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60713))
- **Send Quotes From the Comment Popup**: Hold `⌘` or `Ctrl` in the quote popup to turn its checkmark into send, or press `⌘Enter` or `Ctrl+Enter`, to send just that quote and comment while leaving the rest of the composer untouched. ([#60640](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60640))
- **Percentage Compaction Buffer**: Set `"compaction": { "buffer": "20%" }` in `opencode.json` to keep a share of each model's context window free, so one setting fits models with small and large windows. Token counts still work. ([#60647](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60647))

### Core

#### Improvements

- `compaction.buffer` accepts a percentage of the model's context window, such as `"20%"`, in addition to a token count. ([#60647](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60647))
- When `read` misses because a folder is missing, the error names that folder and the nearest one that exists. ([#60688](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60688))
- When `edit` can't find `oldString`, the error shows the file's closest lines, or says the change is already there. ([#60689](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60689))
- Calls to a tool named `bash` now run as `shell` instead of failing, with the same permissions. A plugin tool actually named `bash` still takes precedence. ([#60687](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60687))

#### Bug fixes

- MCP servers that send stdio messages larger than 10 MiB no longer get disconnected, and large messages are read much faster. ([#60694](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60694))
- Idle locations no longer restart their MCP servers right after shutting down. ([#60668](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60668))
- Compaction now caps its prompt at the model's context window when the input limit is larger. ([#60660](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60660))
- LiteLLM context window errors now trigger compaction instead of stopping the session. ([#60692](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60692))
- Reasoning is no longer turned into plain text when you switch models or resume an interrupted response, which caused request errors on some providers. ([#60498](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60498))

### TUI

#### Bug fixes

- The connect menu no longer lists MCP servers, which are managed in their own place. ([#60675](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60675))

### Desktop

#### Improvements

- Added keyboard shortcuts to choose a worktree and its base branch, shown in tooltips, and a shortcut to toggle shell mode. The worktree path can be selected to copy the full directory. ([#60713](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60713))
- Hold `⌘` or `Ctrl` in the quote popup to send a quote and its comment directly. ([#60640](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60640))
- Added flat input surfaces and a compact input size. ([#60598](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60598))

#### Bug fixes

- The connect menu no longer lists MCP servers. ([#60675](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60675))
- Added the missing top inset to the search field in the recently closed menu. ([#60652](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60652))

releases.title: v2.2.3
releases.body:
### Highlights

- **Use Claude Code in OpenCode**: Install Claude Code, run `claude auth login`, then select **Claude Agent** in `/connect` to use your Claude Code login and models. ([#58782](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58782))
- **Faster Long Sessions in Desktop**: Streaming replies and long conversations now do much less rendering work. ([#60489](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60489), [#60521](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60521), [#60513](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60513), [#60481](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60481))
- **Desktop Stability Fixes**: Fixes side-panel tabs, repeated "Session not found" toasts, and **Open file** over HTTP. ([#60430](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60430), [#60436](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60436), [#60459](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60459), [#60462](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60462))

### Breaking changes

#### TUI plugins require OpenTUI 0.8

`@opencode/plugin` now requires `@opentui/core` and `@opentui/solid` 0.8.0 or later. In OpenTUI 0.8, a ScrollBox's `wrapper`, `viewport`, `content`, and scrollbars are facade objects instead of renderables, and a custom `RenderContext` must implement `clock` and `onAnimationTick`. See the [OpenTUI 0.8.0 release notes](https://opentui.com/docs/releases/0.8.0). ([#60385](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60385))

#### Managed policy: `integration.use` covers integrations only

`integration.use` now controls which integration accounts can be used, and the new `mcp.use`, `skill.use`, and `plugin.use` actions control MCP servers, skills, and plugins. Rules with the old `mcp:`, `skill:`, and `plugin:` resource prefixes are converted automatically, but a bare `integration.use` rule no longer applies to MCP servers, skills, or plugins. ([#60315](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60315))

### Core

#### Improvements

- Added the built-in **Claude Agent** provider. Install Claude Code, run `claude auth login`, and select **Claude Agent** in `/connect`; `OPENCODE_CLAUDE_PATH` can override the Claude executable. Thanks [@Tarquinen](https://github.com/Tarquinen). ([#58782](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58782))
- Added Code Mode JavaScript checks to experimental schedules, including statically authorized tool calls, persistent state, and custom wake messages. ([#60140](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60140))
- Added separate managed-policy actions for connecting to integrations and using integrations, MCP servers, skills, and plugins. ([#60315](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60315))

#### Bug fixes

- Preserved plugin-provided model variants and delayed dynamic provider fallback until external SDK hooks have run. ([#60097](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60097), [#60380](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60380))

releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added `permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories`: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode
- Added an optional `groups` list to Claude apps gateway upstreams: only developers in the listed IdP groups are sent to that upstream, on failover too
- Added `guardrail_trace` to Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, to log which Amazon Bedrock guardrail filter fired on a request, without the matched text
- Added idle compaction to VS Code and Claude Desktop's Code tab: a 200K+ token conversation left idle is summarized, and the summary is used on your next message if the prompt cache has expired
- Fixed sessions failing turn after turn with "Invalid effort level" when an organization's admin caps a model's effort: Claude Code now lowers the effort, retries, and says which level it uses
- Fixed `claude -p` exiting with code 0 and no output when startup failed; it now prints the error and exits 1
- Fixed Bedrock sessions with many images failing every turn and `/compact` with "400 Input is too long." instead of removing older images and compacting
- Fixed Microsoft Foundry sessions failing when the resource has no deployment for the default Sonnet, Opus or Haiku model: Claude Code now falls back to an older model of that family
- Fixed repeated refused requests behind a gateway that doesn't accept tool search's `tool_reference` blocks: the request is sent again once without tool search, and the session remembers
- Fixed TLS connections failing with `UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT` when the system certificate store holds a renewed root certificate that is cross-signed with its predecessor
- Fixed MCP servers that also work without sign-in showing "needs authentication" after their stored sign-in stopped working; they are now used signed out
- Fixed `claude mcp logout` reporting success when the MCP sign-in was not removed, for example while the macOS keychain is locked over SSH
- Fixed extra sign-in renewals when several sessions share an Anthropic profile login and the credentials lock is busy
- Fixed `claude ultrareview` and `claude remote-control` asking the workspace trust question in a CI job that has a terminal; with `CI` set they now refuse an untrusted folder at once
- Fixed an administrator's TLS trust settings in managed settings not being applied in Claude Desktop sessions
- Fixed model switching being refused on machines with managed plugin settings when one of your own `--plugin-dir` or `--plugin-url` plugins had a broken manifest or failed to download
- Fixed the Bedrock and Vertex model upgrade offer coming back at every start when managed settings pin the model
- Fixed `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` set only in remote managed settings no longer applying once the stored copy had expired, which let sessions start without policy when the server could not be reached
- Fixed "Continue automatically at usage limit" continuing more than three times without a prompt from you when a task restarted itself between waits (a /goal check-in, a background or scheduled task)
- Fixed background and cloud sessions started with Ultracode turning it back on at their next start after it had been switched off
- Fixed the last broken reply and its retry prompts staying in the conversation after Claude gave up on a tool call that could not be parsed
- Fixed a PreCompact hook with very large output making compaction fail or repeat; each hook's output is now cut at 10,000 characters
- Fixed background diff refreshes briefly taking the repository's index lock, which could make a git command run at the same moment fail with "Unable to create '.git/index.lock': File exists"
- Fixed markdown tables jumping between grid and stacked layouts on half-typed rows while streaming, and long tables falling back to raw pipes
- Fixed the /resume picker showing the text of CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md as a session's title when the session only ran slash commands
- Fixed `/btw` answer

releases.title: v0.99.0
releases.body:
# Hooks, Catwalk v3!

A big one! Crush now runs on Catwalk v3, hooks can see every part of a run, and editors that host Crush get a whole new set of tools to feel right at home.

## Hooks, everywhere 🪝

Hooks are no longer just about tools. They can now follow the whole run: sessions, turns, permissions and more!

Hooks can now step in after a tool runs, too. Redact secrets from the output before the model sees them, add a note, or stop the turn. If the tool already did something it shouldn't have, your hook can tell the model "you committed without running the tests."

```bash
hook add TurnEnd --name "ding" --command 'afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff'
```

You can read more [here](https://github.com/charmbracelet/crush/tree/main/docs/hooks#readme)

## Client/server mode

If you build something that runs Crush inside it, this release is for you:

- Host themes: the host app can theme the TUI over the server API, so Crush matches your applications.
- Host context: the host can tell Crush what's in view, like open files, and those files appear in completions.
- Append to the next prompt: clients can add text the agent reads with the next prompt, without starting a run or cluttering the chat.
- Shared viewing: clients can see which session other clients are looking at.
- Piped permissions: set `CRUSH_PERMISSIONS_PIPED=1` and the host answers permission prompts, so you aren't asked twice.
- `http://` addresses work as an alias for `tcp://` when starting the server.

## Steadier server

- `SIGHUP` now reloads the config instead of stopping the server.
- Closing the terminal or stopping Crush through a service manager now shuts down gracefully, so work in progress is saved instead of left looking stuck.

## Small overview of [Catwalk v3][catwalk]:

Crush now speaks [Catwalk v3][catwalk]. Provider `type` describes the API format a provider uses, not who made it:

- `completions`: OpenAI-compatible APIs
- `responses`: OpenAI, or anything routed through it
- `messages`: Anthropic-compatible APIs

Your config is migrated automatically when it loads, so `openai`, `openai-compat` and `anthropic` keep working. No edits needed.

The `provider add` and `model add` flags follow along:

```bash
crush provider add deepseek \
  --type completions \
  --base-url "https://api.deepseek.com/v1" \
  --api-key "$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"

crush model add deepseek/deepseek-chat --thinking toggleable --max-attachments 5
```

- `--can-reason` is now `--thinking always|never|toggleable`
- `--max-attachments N` is new
- Reasoning levels show friendly names in the picker, like "X-High"

[catwalk]: https://github.com/charmbracelet/catwalk/releases/tag/v3.0.0

That's all for now!
Charm XX 💫

## Changelog
### New!
* 9dac45bdfa3e978a76c595b238c5a5f37915c748: feat(config): declare the hook event list and validate hooks against it (@taciturnaxolotl)
* bdc53ce00036b0a4ecef3fa7559d9f6e0a47581e: feat(hooks): add PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure (@taciturnaxolotl)
* 48c0224d2cbfaa24c4196caf4788b31589b1cf55: feat(hooks): add session, turn, permission and compaction lifecycle hooks (@taciturnaxolotl)
* 27cb41b943ec9c4522f1928b2877b01a2139436f: feat(permission): tell subscribers when a prompt is cancelled (@taciturnaxolotl)
* a0f462f39330d1cdef52ecd2e9bf8695cc445181: feat(server): host context (#4148) (@andrinoff)
* 94592ce338bc766685775d4a85a1ffcd8acbdf54: feat(server): let client append to next prompt (#4176) (@andrinoff)
* aae2ee262ce236f3b649fd4490a6a35301b6f7e2: feat(server): reload config on SIGHUP instead of stopping (@taciturnaxolotl)
* 52dd976b9ca94ab108c0b4be7e7f52071a303aed: feat(server): tell clients which session other clients view (#4178) (@andrinoff)
* a2c8a9519bf0a883b3c14826a7e6ca8e9397ca98: feat: Catwalk v3 (#3829) (@andrinoff)
* 334982499a89f2cffb8311afd78e253568e1ac01: feat: allow a host application theme the TUI over server API (#4127) (@andrinoff)

### Highlights

- **Keep Working Toward a Goal**: Run `/goal <objective>` in the TUI or Desktop to let the session continue until a reviewer confirms the objective is met. Use `/goal pause`, `/goal resume`, or `/goal clear` to control it. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))
- **Generate Images**: Enable `experimental.image_generate` to let agents create or edit images with the new `image_generate` tool. You can optionally set its default model with `experimental.image_generate.model`. ([#59939](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59939), [#60096](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60096))

- **New Default Model Picker**: Search favorites, recent models, providers, and variants from the redesigned model picker, which is now the default in Desktop. ([#59997](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59997))

### Breaking changes

#### `@opencode/ai` provider removals and renames

These changes affect code that imports `@opencode/ai` directly. They don't change the CLI, Desktop, or the HTTP API.

- The fal, Black Forest Labs, Replicate, and Stability providers are removed, along with their `./providers/fal`, `./providers/black-forest-labs`, `./providers/replicate`, and `./providers/stability` entry points. ([#59977](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59977))
- Five legacy entry points are removed. Import the nested paths instead, which 2.2.0 already exports: `./providers/amazon-bedrock-mantle` → `./providers/amazon-bedrock/mantle`, and `./providers/google-vertex-chat`, `-interactions`, `-mistral`, and `-responses` → `./providers/google-vertex/chat`, `/interactions`, `/mistral`, and `/responses`. ([#59506](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59506))
- Each provider's `configure()` input type is now named `Config`, for example `Groq.LanguageModelOptions` → `Groq.Config`, and `model()` settings are optional when every setting is optional. ([#59765](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59765))

### Core

#### Improvements

- Add `/goal <objective>` with pause, resume, and clear controls, plus automatic progress review until the objective is met. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))
- Add opt-in scheduled prompts through `/schedule`, agent tools, and `experimental.schedules`. ([#59401](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59401), [#59457](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59457))
- Add the opt-in `image_generate` tool for background image creation and editing, with automatic or configured model selection. ([#59939](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59939), [#60096](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60096))
- Offer GPT Image 2 after Codex sign-in and add MiniMax and Meta Muse image generation support. ([#60085](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60085), [#59929](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59929), [#60081](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60081))
- Add Responses API support for OpenRouter, DigitalOcean, and Venice, including freeform tools. ([#59991](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59991), [#59963](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59963))
- Improve snapshot performance by coalescing captures and avoiding repeated ignore-file work. ([#59419](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59419))

#### Bug fixes

- Preserve more context headroom when fitting tool output into the context window. ([#59934](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59934))
- Retry provider throttling correctly instead of reporting it as context overflow. ([#59649](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59649))
- Send image-edit references and image sizes in the formats expected by OpenRouter, Google, and Vercel Grok. ([#60067](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60067), [#59927]

releases.title: JetBrains 7.2.1-rc.1
releases.body:
### Added

- Added hosted Kilo Cloud sessions to Agent Manager. Cloud workspaces now share the same editor chrome as local and worktree sessions, including session rows, date groups, badges, busy spinners, and refresh from the row menu.
- Cloud discovery now pages through every workspace for a repository, reports the canonical status vocabulary instead of showing healthy workspaces as unknown, and shows the hourly compute price in the workspace header.
- Linked custom router entries to platform benchmarks.
- Indexing now prunes ignored directories and bounds LanceDB index growth.

### Fixed

- Cloud sessions recover their streams after reconnects without leaving tools running or hiding wake progress, and preparation failures are surfaced with sanitized error details.
- Kept hosted stream ownership across restarts and retained transcript subscriptions when the first attachment fails transiently.
- Kept large Cloud repositories from bursting the CLI with concurrent workspace status reads.
- Aligned hosted prompts with the Cloud input contract.
- Established a session's event subscription before startup returns so early updates are not missed.
- Compaction now runs at the configured threshold and stops compaction loops, and chunked compaction gets the normal output budget.
- Scheduled tasks fire once across processes sharing a data directory.
- Kept a reply that another Kilo process is still writing, and preserved the real exit code of a failed background job.
- Restricted browser and MCP OAuth URLs to HTTP(S), and scoped the MCP SSE probe to its own request and redirects.
- Blocked compromised eMudhra certificates.

releases.title: v2.1.312
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added `oidc.user_id_claim` to the Claude apps gateway, to identify people by an id_token claim other than `sub`, such as Microsoft Entra ID's `oid`
- Added click to send: in fullscreen, clicking the "to send now" hint under a queued message sends it right away, as its key does
- Fixed managed settings and organization policy not being fetched for the rest of the session after signing in from the VS Code extension
- Fixed Claude overwriting a very large CLAUDE.md, rules file or @-included file in a subdirectory after seeing only its start; Write now asks Claude to read it all or edit in place
- Fixed per-directory and `paths:` skills not being found after a Bash `cd` deeper into a git repository
- Fixed a rare case where the first reply after resuming a session in the terminal could be missing the next time the session was resumed
- Fixed a command with an invalid name stopping all commands from loading, which could leave `claude -p` with no output
- Fixed the Read tool sometimes failing on PDF pages with "pdftoppm failed: Could not write image" when the clean-up of old session files ran at the same time
- Fixed the spinner, OpenTelemetry `effort` values and transcripts naming a newly picked effort level during a task before the model applied it; they now show the level in force
- Fixed the `/model` and `/effort` cache warning saying the re-read waits for your next message; a change made while Claude is working can trigger it sooner
- Fixed some sessions showing as waiting on you when the last message only mentioned items waiting on you mid-sentence
- Fixed agent view restoring input text on the next launch after it was cleared with Ctrl+C just before exiting
- Fixed agent view reopening in shell mode after exiting with Ctrl+D from an empty `!` input
- Fixed vim mode `d`, `c` and `y` with a `gj` or `gk` count larger than the lines left deleting or copying text; like Vim, they now only move the cursor
- Fixed `/verify` showing a long description meant for Claude in `/help` and the `/` command menu instead of a short one
- Improved the prompt's effort indicator: a change made mid-task now says it may wait for your next message, and the note clears when it no longer applies
- Improved WebFetch errors in cloud sessions: a host that does not resolve is now explained as possibly outside the allowed network domains, so Claude names the host to allow
- Changed Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and Mantle to use the shorter system prompt for model names Claude Code doesn't recognize, such as custom deployment names and inference profile ARNs, even when they front Sonnet or Haiku; set `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=0` to keep the full prompt
- Changed automatic model switches after a flagged message to also cover model names Claude Code doesn't recognize, such as custom deployment names; set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK=1` to turn them off
- Changed usage limit messages to call the 5-hour window the "5-hour limit" instead of the "session limit"
- Changed cloud sessions started from the CLI to get their names and branch names from the server
- Changed prompt and agent hooks to run at most 24 at a time per session, sub-agents included, plus at most 12 that have waited longer than their event's timeout; a `timeout` under 1 second now counts as 1 second
- Changed a subagent's `autoCompactWindow` to lower the window set by `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW`, where it had no effect before; it still never raises that window
- Changed OpenTelemetry `mcp_server.name` to report the real name of fixed-URL remote MCP servers declared by plugins from the official Anthropic marketplace, instead of `custom`
- Changed Claude Code to stop sending the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event
- [VSCode] Fixed sessions ending on a bare exit code when your organization's settings couldn't be loaded or were refused at startup; the tab now says why and offers Retry or Sign in again
- [VSCode] Changed usage limit resets to show a cl

releases.title: v2.2.0
releases.body:
### Highlights

- Create, install and share [Desktop plugins](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/build/plugins/gui) (experimental) ([#55246](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/55246), [#59469](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59469), [#59489](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59489))
- Refreshed the desktop app experience ([#56898](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/56898), [#58865](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58865), [#55838](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/55838), [#57962](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/57962))
- Add experimental image and decision generation APIs to plugins and sdk, allowing image generation or decision model (think typesafe, clef, etc) workflows. ([#59190](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59190), [#59380](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59380), [#58758](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58758))
- Plugins can now attach and update keyed session instructions with ctx.session.instructions.entry.put/list/remove. Instead of editing the system prompt and busting the prompt cache, each change is added as a small update at the next step. The entries also survive compaction and reverts, and they don't start an extra model turn. ([#56550](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/56550))
- Restored the Todo tool in desktop via opt-in ([#59092](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59092))
- Add configurable prompt cache TTLs per provider/model ([#59157](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59157))

### Breaking changes

#### `@opencode/ai` root is now the Promise API

`@opencode/ai` now works like `@opencode/sdk` and `@opencode/client`: the package root exports the Promise API, and the Effect API moved to `@opencode/ai/effect`. `@opencode/ai/promise` is removed, and the wildcard subpath export is replaced with an explicit list of provider and protocol entry points. ([#58847](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58847), [#59183](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59183))

```diff
-import { AI } from "@opencode/ai/promise"
-import { LLM } from "@opencode/ai"
+import { AI } from "@opencode/ai"
+import { LLM } from "@opencode/ai/effect"
```

#### The OpenCode GitHub Action is removed

The OpenCode GitHub Action is no longer published. Remove it from your workflows. ([#59032](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59032))

#### TUI plugins require OpenTUI 0.7

`@opencode/plugin` now requires `@opentui/core` and `@opentui/solid` 0.7.0, up from 0.6.8 or later. Plugins that depend on OpenTUI 0.6 fail to install until they upgrade. In OpenTUI 0.7, custom renderables read their hooks from their class at construction: assign `renderBefore`, `renderAfter`, and `onLifecyclePass` in the constructor instead of as class fields, call `refreshHooks()` after adding a hook by reflection, and replace `defineNativeIntegration()` with a `static nativeIntegration` declaration. See the [OpenTUI 0.7.0 release notes](https://opentui.com/docs/releases/0.7.0). ([#59295](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59295))

### Core

#### Improvements

- Add experimental image and decision generation API endpoints. ([#59190](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59190))
- Add image and decision entrypoints for catalog providers. ([#59380](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59380))
- Improve integration rebuild performance. ([#59402](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59402))
- Let custom model configuration set a model type. ([#59388](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59388))
- Let model-list API requests filter by type. ([#59355](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59355))
- Make external-directory permission checks use the project's filesystem. ([#59089](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59089))
- Reduce memory use when code search finds very large lines. ([#59205](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59205))
- Let plugins filter event subscriptions by type. ([#58864](ht

releases.title: v4.1.26
releases.body:
### Added

- Cloud tasks: Settings > API Configuration has a Local | Cloud toggle when cloud sessions are on. Cloud picks the Cline model new cloud tasks run on, saved separately from your local models. Clicking the model label in a cloud session's composer opens it there.
- Starting or resuming a cloud sandbox shows a progress card with the repo, branch and steps (start sandbox, clone repository, start agent). It collapses once the agent starts.

### Changed

- Cloud sessions hide the Plan/Act toggle and the auto-approve bar instead of showing them disabled.
- With no model chosen, the Cline provider uses Claude Sonnet 5.5 again, which is back at the top of Cline's recommended list.
- Model requests retry at most 3 times instead of 5.
- Kimi K3 now gets `max` reasoning for Extra High and Max, instead of an `xhigh` setting it rejects.
- Refreshed the model catalog. Adds the CommandCode, Reflection, Liquid Inference and Munito AI providers and drops CrofAI, iFlow and Llama. The Cline free list adds Reflection Beam, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and Laguna S 2.1 and drops Mimo V2.6 Flash and Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor. ClinePass now defaults to Kimi K3.1 Pro and adds MiniMax M3.1 Flash and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017. Default models change for most other providers, mostly to Kimi K3.1 Pro, MiniMax M3.1 Flash or DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017. If you use a provider without pinning a model, expect a different default.

### Fixed

- GPT-6 models (such as `gpt-6-sol` and `gpt-6.1-sol`) work on OpenAI and Azure OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and SAP AI Core no longer rejects requests with "Unsupported parameter: 'max_tokens'". Both now get `max_completion_tokens`.
- Gemini API keys (the `gemini` provider) no longer send native Google Search. Free-tier keys failed every turn with a 429 quota error on Gemini 3+, and on Gemini 2.x every Cline tool was dropped.
- Toggling Plan/Act while a task is starting no longer drops your first prompt, and the session no longer keeps running with the other mode's tools.
- Disabled rules stay disabled.
- Starting a command no longer moves keyboard focus into the terminal, so text you're typing in the chat no longer lands in the shell.
- Cancelling a task or opening another one while Cline is asking a question no longer lets your next message get taken as the answer to the old question.
- A turn whose connection drops after the model has streamed only reasoning is now retried instead of ending the task.
- Auto-compaction no longer runs for models with an unknown context limit, and it no longer runs again every few tool calls after the first compaction.
- `ask_question`: the model keeps going after you pick an option, and empty answers are rejected.
- `run_commands` with an empty command list now returns an error instead of a silent success. On PowerShell, the tool tells the model how quote escaping works and to confirm recursive deletes first.
- Task header badges wrap instead of hiding the close button, the GitHub connection check no longer flashes a loading indicator, and the Local/Cloud toggle's padding is fixed.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/v4.1.25...v4.1.26
