releases.title: SDK v0.2.0
releases.body:
- Starting a session that already has a run in progress now reattaches to the live session instead of replacing its runtime. Before, the original run kept going but couldn't be reached, and its transcript writes landed on a stale snapshot. A start that includes a prompt while a run is in progress is rejected
- The hub records every client that registered a capability for a session, including clients that join a task that's already running, and sends each request to the first one still connected. If none is left, the request fails quickly with a message the user can act on, instead of waiting forever
- A turn whose connection drops after the model has streamed only reasoning is now retried, and the partial reasoning is discarded. Turns with text, media or tool calls are still never retried
- Model requests retry at most 3 times after the first attempt (down from 5). Failed attempts are recorded in Langfuse traces, and cancelled requests are no longer reported as Langfuse errors
- AI SDK updated to `ai` 7.0.136 / `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` 5.0.58. `max` reasoning now reaches the provider: the gateway no longer turns it into `xhigh`, and Kimi K3 gets `max` for Extra High and Max. Empty Anthropic turns are still retried despite the new `anthropic.*` custom stream parts
- The `gemini` provider no longer sends native Google Search. On Gemini 3+, free-tier keys failed every turn with a 429 quota error, and on Gemini 2.x it dropped every Cline tool. Vertex keeps native search
- Auto-compaction no longer runs when the model's input limit is unknown. Manual and overflow-recovery compaction still work
- After the first compaction, the size estimate now uses the messages as they are actually sent, with tool results truncated. Before, it overestimated about 7x and compaction ran again every few tool calls
- Checkpoint diffs read file contents with a single `git cat-file --batch` process instead of up to two `git show` processes per file. Workspaces with many untracked files used to spawn thousands of git processes
- SSH remotes work behind a ProxyJump alias. The connect budget goes from 10s to 30s, the per-command limit to 60s, and tunnel readiness to 40s. When ssh exits mid-upload, its real error is reported instead of `EPIPE`, and a `LocalForward` on the alias no longer collides with the tunnel
- `ask_question` answers are framed so the model keeps going after a bare choice. Empty answers are rejected, and an answer with only an attachment counts as answered
- `run_commands` rejects an empty `commands` list with a tool error, and its schema now advertises `minItems: 1`
- On PowerShell, the `run_commands` description explains backtick escaping, single-quoting literal paths, preferring cmdlets over `cmd /c`, and confirming recursive deletes first
- Plugin commands run in the active session runtime and the hub. Plugin watches start working again when discovery directories appear
- Compiled binaries load embedded plugin and dashboard resources straight from the binary, and every declared SDK runtime export is packaged
- A configured `CLINE_PLUGIN_RUNTIME_DIR` is resolved to an absolute path
- When OpenRouter has no match for a Cline recommended model, its capabilities are filled in from the Vercel catalog
- Desktop cloud session orchestration moved into the hub. `session.list` reports `activeCloudCommands`, and the hub isn't replaced while cloud commands are still running
- Core adds conversation summaries and cloud continuation support
- Run stall telemetry: `agent.run-finished` and `agent.run-failed` carry stall signals from a new `RunHealthObserver`
- `@cline/ui` now ships with the SDK packages on the shared version. It adds a `Kbd` component and token chips for slash commands and file mentions in `AgentComposer`
- Refreshed the model catalog (7,041 → 6,457 models). Adds the Liquid Inference, Munito AI and Munito AI (EU) providers and drops CrofAI, iFlow and Llama. The Cline free list adds Reflection Beam, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and Laguna

releases.title: v2.1.310
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added the Monitor tool and plugin monitors on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry or nonessential traffic is disabled; long foreground sleeps are now blocked there too
- Fixed requests failing behind some gateways and compatible servers that reject the `effort-2025-11-24` beta value or mid-conversation system messages; Claude Code now retries without them
- Fixed background cleanup deleting some recent files, such as pasted images, when `cleanupPeriodDays` is set to a very large value
- Fixed compaction after a "Prompt is too long" error keeping too much of a conversation with dense text, such as base64 or SVG, so the next request could fail again
- Fixed file read permission prompts not showing where a symbolic link leads
- Fixed a question's auto-continue timeout firing the moment the external editor closed after a long edit
- Windows: Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks letting a tool call through when Git Bash is missing and the hook's command is only quoted strings, such as a quoted path
- Improved auto mode's prompt before the first read outside the working directories: it now says when blocking those reads makes shell commands ask for permission
- Improved memory use of non-interactive sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK) during compaction when the transcript file is very large
- Improved a mod's `Image` to draw inside tmux with `allow-passthrough` and `focus-events` on, in kitty, Ghostty, and iTerm2 3.5+ with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its `alt` text
- Linux: Improved `/sandbox` and the sandbox startup warning to name Ubuntu's AppArmor restriction on user namespaces, and how to lift it, when it keeps bubblewrap from starting the sandbox
- Changed the error for an MCP tool call that times out in a non-interactive session while the server's elicitation is unanswered: it now tells Claude that no answer came and not to repeat the call
- [VSCode] Fixed pressing Enter on the plan review card's "Send feedback and keep planning" button approving the plan instead of sending your comments back
- [VSCode] Fixed the panel showing "Something went wrong" after "Switch branch & continue" on a cloud session opened from Session history's Web tab
- [Cloud sessions] Added Claude Code cloud sessions and Remote Control permissions to Enterprise custom roles, so Owners can control access to each by role
- [Cloud sessions] Added a Choose file button to load a cloud environment's setup script from a file
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed failed saves and archives in the cloud environment edit dialog showing no error inside the dialog
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed failed routine API token actions showing only a toast; the error now appears in the routine edit dialog
- [Cloud sessions] Improved the session start checklist to show a cloud environment's setup script output in a scrolling box
- [Cloud sessions] Changed turning on Cloud sessions or Remote Control in admin settings to ask for confirmation and list the custom roles that have that permission
- [Cloud sessions] Changed the cloud environment dialog to open network access, setup script and environment variables from rows instead of listing every editor at once
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag treating `!` commands such as `!restart` and `!help` as ordinary messages when sent in bold, italic or strikethrough
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag admin channel and workspace pages being replaced by a load error when a background refresh of the bundle list fails
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings reporting that no channels match a filter while channel names are still loading
- [Code Review] Fixed the Code Review admin section hiding its repositories and switches after a failed refresh of the repository list
- [Code Review] Improved the Code Review admin section to retry the first load and show one Try again banner when it still fails

## New Features

- Windows HTTPS and WebSocket connections now handle proxy authentication challenges using the signed-in user’s Negotiate or NTLM credentials. (#55994, #56000)
- CLI configuration overrides are preserved when `-c` or `--config` appears at multiple subcommand levels. (#56022)
- Queued prompts now wait for pending permission selections to resolve before continuing. (#55682)
- Hardened sandbox checks for case-variant metadata paths on macOS and replaceable symlinks used to locate executables. (#54273, #55384)

releases.title: v2.1.309
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on macOS and Linux running the shell's startup files outside the sandbox before each command
- Fixed macOS sandbox `denyWrite` glob patterns not applying at a path's real location when the pattern's folder is reached through a symlink
- Fixed sandboxed commands and auto-accepted edits being able to modify the MCP config file passed with `--mcp-config`
- Fixed a disabled MCP server being reconnected by a later permission prompt in print and SDK sessions
- Fixed the Bash permission check trusting a variable set by a command whose redirect can fail to open
- Fixed Bash permission checks not prompting for some compound commands that change directory before running git when the `cd` is wrapped or prefixed, as they do for a plain `cd`
- Fixed an `Edit(path)` deny rule not blocking a Bash redirect to that path in some commands that also held a subshell
- Fixed worktree-isolated sessions accepting some locale-prefixed commands the isolation guard should refuse
- Fixed worktree-isolated sessions on zsh accepting some arithmetic commands that the isolation guard should refuse
- Fixed worktrees and branch checkouts that Claude Code creates so they ignore git replace refs, as its other git operations already do
- Fixed profile store write protection not applying when the config directory is reached through a symlink
- Fixed sessions compacting repeatedly after reading files under a very large nested CLAUDE.md; a nested CLAUDE.md over the size limit now loads only its start
- Fixed ctrl+enter (send now) only queuing a message when pressed before the response had started, and restarting a prompt's hooks while leaving the message queued when pressed while those hooks were running
- Fixed key-bound slash commands running in the shell from `!` mode
- Fixed ctrl+o not showing messages from other agents and sessions that are still waiting to be delivered; they now appear in full under the transcript, marked as waiting
- Fixed long tool output previews being cut through an emoji, leaving session transcripts that `jq` could not parse
- Fixed Read reporting "File does not exist" for PDF page ranges in Linux sandboxes that share the parent's `/proc`
- Fixed messages from a Claude Desktop-hosted session sometimes being lost when its connection refreshed
- Fixed features missing from Claude Code sessions in the Claude desktop app when the terminal on the same computer was signed in to a different account or organization
- Fixed the `claude remote-control` status line showing `HEAD` as the branch for a folder that is not in a git repository
- Fixed split-pane agent teammates not inheriting the tool deny and `--tools` rules given on the leader's command line
- Fixed sessions renamed with `/rename` appearing to other sessions under a generated name after a VS Code window reload or a non-interactive `--resume`
- Fixed the `/rewind` list showing "No code changes" for a turn that changed checkpointed files through `/code-review --fix`, a subagent or a shell command
- Fixed `/privacy-settings` showing an out-of-date "Help improve our AI models" value; it now also says when the setting can't be fetched
- Fixed feedback saying "try again later" when your organization does not accept feedback; it now shows the server's reason and where to report a bug
- Fixed oversized /feedback reports failing instead of being resent without the transcript
- Fixed a skill in an `--add-dir` folder being unreachable when another skill already held its name; it is now offered as `<folder>:<name>`
- Fixed `/verify` and `/code-review` not finding a nested package's own skill when its files were changed from the shell
- Fixed the /claude-api skill saying that `ant beta:worker poll --on-work` passes trace context to the command
- Fixed the /claude-api skill's C# tracing setup missing spans from the cloud platform clients
- Fixed the /claude-api skill saying that API spans for requests to Claude Platform on AWS can't join the caller's

releases.body:

## Highlights

_See the complete change list below._

## Breaking Changes

No known breaking changes.

## Complete Change List

### Features

- feat(daemon): support session-targeted Skill and Extension refresh ([#14050](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14050)) by @callmeYe
- feat(runtime-broker): Session-create warm for Workspace-isolated bound Sessions ([#14599](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14599)) by @doudouOUC
- feat(managed-agent): ship a configuration template in the reference distribution ([#14631](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14631)) by @wenshao
- feat(serve): run private CSI file turns through Hosted Harness ([#14487](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14487)) by @doudouOUC
- feat(managed-agent): support local and SSH workspace file references ([#14639](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14639)) by @doudouOUC
- Adds a read-only --check preflight that prints PASS, WARN, FAIL, or SKIP for managed-agent deployment checks and exits nonzero on failure. ([#14632](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14632)) by @wenshao
- Lets a successor Hosted owner finish private CSI file turns that already have durable receipts, preserving tool responses and avoiding repeated file operations. ([#14523](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14523)) by @doudouOUC
- Managed Agent submissions now accept up to 8 MiB of attachment input, preserve large pending requests across refresh, and let users discard unrecoverable drafts. ([#14628](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14628)) by @doudouOUC
- Hosted Turn recovery now asks the Runtime Broker for execution evidence and treats unprovable outcomes as unknown instead of transient faults. ([#14669](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14669)) by @wenshao
- Adds systemd units and setup guidance for single-host managed-agent deployments so Runtime workers stay running when Broker restarts ([#14633](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14633)) by @wenshao
- Parks managed-agent turns with unknown Runtime outcomes for later rechecks instead of repeatedly retrying cancellation, keeping them active and avoiding false FAILED results ([#14681](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14681)) by @wenshao
- feat(artifacts): record files the agent creates or edits ([#14292](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14292)) by @zjgzx1988
- Adds a managed-agent credential bootstrap that generates required deployment tokens and writes protected configuration to simplify secure setup. ([#14634](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14634)) by @wenshao
- Completes private CSI cold recovery so settled file work can resume from saved results without repeating file effects or extra model requests. ([#14695](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14695)) by @doudouOUC
- Adds an optional Generated UI extension that renders model-generated HTML/CSS cards with bounded local JavaScript, letting users adjust inputs without another model turn. ([#14338](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14338)) by @qqqys
- feat(workflow): authorize daemon ancestor workflows ([#14646](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14646)) by @qqqys
- feat(web-shell): show per-model TTFT and output speed in Token Usage ([#14728](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14728)) by @qqqys
- feat(runtime): add original CSI application retirement ([#14698](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14698)) by @doudouOUC
- feat(telemetry): Record reasoning effort on LLM spans ([#14718](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14718)) by @zonemeen

releases.title: v1.4.0
releases.body:
### New Features

- **Image input for classifiers**: codemode `models.classify()` accepts `images` for TypeSafe's Jev and Cloudflare's Clef models on `typesafe`, `cloudflare-workers-ai`, and OpenRouter. See [Use classifier models](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/models.md#use-classifier-models) and [Codemode](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/codemode.md#models).
- **Models Configuration reference**: every provider, model, model override, and compatibility field of `models.json`, generated from its schema. See [Models Configuration](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/models-configuration.md).
- **Summaries without a fixed output cap**: compaction and branch summaries use the model's output limit, so long reasoning no longer makes them fail. See [Compaction](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/compaction.md#compaction).
- **Codemode waits for a free worker**: parallel scripts and in-process subagents queue instead of failing, and `PI_CODEMODE_MAX_WORKERS` raises the limit. See [Codemode limits](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.4.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/codemode.md#limits).
- **Rex terminal support**: OSC 8 hyperlinks, truecolor, and inline images.

### Added

- Added a Models Configuration reference generated from the `models.json` schema, listing all provider, model, model override, and compatibility fields ([#10790](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10790))
- Codemode `models.classify()` now accepts `images` for TypeSafe's Jev and Cloudflare's Clef models on `typesafe`, `cloudflare-workers-ai`, and OpenRouter, and lists Clef Omni and Jev 1.14 on Workers AI.
- Provider-level `compat` in `models.json` now also applies to classifier models, with the System One fields `imageInput` and `sendImageOptInHeader` for proxies that serve another service's classifiers. Extension classifier models accept `compat` too.
- Added `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` to the `minimax` and `minimax-cn` providers, with thinking levels low through max ([#11121](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11121))
- Added support for the Rex terminal: OSC 8 hyperlinks, truecolor, and inline images ([#11131](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/11131), [#11150](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11150) by [@petrroll](https://github.com/petrroll), [#11183](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/11183) by [@nihaals](https://github.com/nihaals))

### Changed

- Provider attribution headers now come from pi-ai's client identity. Extensions' `before_provider_headers` handlers no longer see the OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, and OpenCode attribution headers; returning `null` for one still removes it. Cloudflare requests send pi's detailed `User-Agent` instead of `pi-coding-agent`, as do GitHub release checks for tool downloads, and OpenCode requests send `x-opencode-client` whenever attribution is enabled, not only with a session.
- `generateSummary()` and `generateSummaryWithUsage()` now ignore their `reserveTokens` parameter. Summary requests use the model's output limit instead.
- Changed the default GitHub Copilot model from `gpt-5.4`, which Copilot retired, to `gpt-6.1-sol`.
- Changed the default NVIDIA model to `nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b` ([#10910](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10910) by [@cv](https://github.com/cv))
- Changed the default Xiaomi model to `mimo-v2.6-pro` for the `xiaomi` and Xiaomi Token Plan providers, since `mimo-v2.5-pro` left the catalog.
- Grok 4.3 and Grok 4.5 on the `xai` provider now offer the `xhigh` thinking level.
- Sign in with ChatGPT: ChatGPT Business workspace usage-limit errors are not retried and tell the user to ask their workspace admin to increase the limit.

### Fixed

- Fixed compaction and branch summaries failing with "generation hit the token cap" when reasoning used most of the fixed summary output li

releases.title: v2.1.307
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added `/claude-api api-version` to move Claude API code to API version `2026-10-21`
- Added the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back
- Fixed requests failing with a model-not-found error when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` is set and the model is an alias with the `[1m]` suffix, such as `opus[1m]`
- Fixed the `prompt-caching-scope` beta header being sent behind custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateways and on Foundry, where it has no effect
- Fixed MCP servers showing "needs authentication" in `claude -p` on macOS while the login keychain was locked; they now say why, and the next run after an unlock connects without a new sign-in
- Fixed MCP servers being reported as timed out, and staying failed in headless runs, when a macOS or Linux computer went to sleep while they were connecting
- Fixed HTTP MCP tool calls being sent twice when the connection closed mid-call; only read-only or idempotent tools are now retried
- Fixed a turn sometimes starting without an SDK MCP server's latest tools when a background task was running
- Fixed some "Autocompact is thrashing" errors in turns that read many PDF pages, images or other large tool results
- Fixed `/autocompact` in cloud sessions going back to the default window after the session restarted
- Fixed a conversation cleared with `/clear` sometimes coming back when a cloud or self-hosted runner session restarted
- Fixed `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` being ignored in Claude apps gateway sessions
- Fixed telemetry from Claude Desktop sessions behind a Claude apps gateway being rejected when `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` is set
- Fixed `/permissions` > Recently denied not showing the denied shell command, and auto mode's local classifier ignoring an approval from there when it checks a retried command; approving a row now names the command, not its description
- Fixed `/help` and the `/` command menu showing long model-facing descriptions for bundled skills such as `/claude-api` instead of their short descriptions
- Fixed subagent transcripts recording placeholder token usage and an empty stop reason for streamed responses
- Fixed model switches through the Agent SDK's `setModel()`, and apps built on it, being refused when the API took more than 5 seconds to confirm the model; Claude Code now waits up to 15 seconds
- Fixed a background command stopped through a connected app (such as the desktop app archiving an idle session) being reported to Claude as stopped by the user; the notice now names its output file
- Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions reporting a tool error when a site answered with a 4xx status or a robots.txt refusal; it is now a normal result, as in local sessions
- Fixed write tools on a directly configured GitHub MCP server showing a form that closed without creating anything in the desktop app's Code tab
- Fixed Artifact tool reads failing with a connection reset when the server had closed a reused connection
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` committing a `.claude/settings.local.json` left in the clone by an earlier session
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held
- Improved recovery from unparseable tool calls: Claude Code now retries the call up to twice before ending the turn with an error
- Improved fork subagents launched together: each is now told which launch is its own, so forks are much less likely to try to start each other's work
- Improved browser sign-in: the success page now appears as soon as sign-in completes, without waiting for your account profile to load
- Improved web search errors in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions: a search refused with a 403 that gives a reason now shows that reason instead of a generic "Authenticat

releases.body:
Qwen CUA Driver prebuilt binaries
(vendored under `packages/cua-driver`).

- **macOS**: codesigned + notarized universal binary + `QwenCuaDriver.app`
- **Linux**: unsigned (x86_64 + arm64, glibc 2.31 floor)
- **Windows**: unsigned UIAccess worker + native SDK payload
  (x86_64 + arm64); deployments must sign and trust the worker
  on the target machine before UIAccess activation
- **Node.js**: the same workflow publishes `@qwen-code/cua-sdk`
  after a clean install against these release assets and publishes
  the same-version browser SDK and `@qwen-code/node-repl-mcp` package
  after its MCP protocol smoke tests

Enable relative coordinates: `CUA_DRIVER_RS_COORDINATE_SPACE=1`
(default `0` = off; optional `CUA_DRIVER_RS_COORDINATE_SCALE=1000`).

Enable textual MCP payload filtering for affected model API routes:
`MCP_MODEL_PAYLOAD_FILTER=1` (default off).

releases.title: v2.1.305
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added `sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces` so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset
- Fixed every request failing on Vertex, Bedrock and other providers when the endpoint or a gateway rejects tool search, and behind gateways with ToolSearch disallowed or left out of `--tools` (a 2.1.304 regression): Claude Code now retries without it
- Fixed `/effort` and `/autocompact` settings not applying when the model name differed from a `modelOverrides` value by letter case or a `[1m]` tag
- Fixed new worktrees in a bare repository sometimes starting from local HEAD instead of the default branch, and unchanged subagent worktrees sometimes not being cleaned up
- Fixed Bash commands on a full disk failing with a raw `ENOSPC` file path: the error now says the disk is full and that nothing ran
- Fixed an MCP server passed by a cloud session or by the SDK's `setMcpServers` being replaced later in the session by a same-named server from your own settings
- Fixed Claude naming the wrong model for a subagent's work after the subagent switched to a fallback model
- Fixed cloud sessions and teammates not telling Claude when a compaction had to leave the oldest messages out of its summary to fit
- Fixed more cases of scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give
- Fixed Workflow resume re-running already-completed `pipeline()` and `parallel()` agents instead of serving them from the run's journal
- Fixed Remote Control leaving empty "(session)" entries in `/resume` after switching conversations with `/resume`
- Fixed `/usage` rows being cut off in narrow terminals
- Fixed startup warnings printing as raw text above the logo: they now go to the debug log, and permission rules that restrict nothing show as warning rows under the banner
- Fixed screen reader mode: search boxes now say "Search:" instead of a symbol VoiceOver read as "telephone recorder", and highlighted prompt text, such as Ctrl+R search matches and "ultrathink", no longer has spaces inside words
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed a start script that shares only its stdout with the runner or orchestrator failing with `Resource temporarily unavailable` when `TERM` is set (a 2.1.300 regression)
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed repository access failing since 2.1.296 when a git credential helper or askpass program reads its settings through `GIT_CONFIG`
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed the orchestrator reporting a spawn-runner hook as timed out when a runner it started in the background kept its output open
- Improved `/usage`: each warning is now a one-line fix that names its source, and `f` applies the fixes; the same fixes appear in VS Code and `/doctor`
- Improved MCP consent dialogs so an Enter meant for the prompt is less likely to be taken as Accept
- Improved a mod's `Image` to draw its picture in iTerm2 3.5 and later with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its `alt` text
- Remote Control: Improved the spawn-mode messages: pressing `w` now says the new mode is saved for the folder, and a later `claude remote-control` start that uses the saved mode says where it came from
- Changed `allowedMcpServers` to stop filtering `managed-mcp.json` stdio servers that use `${VAR}` only in `env`: one your allowlist left out now loads on upgrade; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep it off
- Changed plugins that Claude Desktop mounts by path to no longer keep their `allowed-tools` when your organization's managed settings set `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`
- Changed the `/artifacts` delete confirmation to take 1 or Enter to keep, 2 to delete, and Esc to cancel; `y` and `n` no longer answer it
- Changed a mod's docked pane to st

## VS Code

### 7.8.15

#### Patch Changes

- [#15235](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15235) [`c61a974`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/c61a974f983c0ff7853b776781945856dbf28dbf) - Let the `browser_open` permission prompt remember your choice. The prompt now offers the current origin and all origins as always-allow rules, and Auto-Approve settings list `browser_open` so you can allow Integrated Browser navigation without answering each request.

### 7.8.13

#### Minor Changes

- [#14866](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14866) [`f01b273`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/f01b273c1343538764c6f1fe43feee41b5521863) - Let a primary agent choose which agent runs an Agent Manager session it starts, so a session fanned out through Agent Manager can run a custom agent (and its edit/bash/MCP permission rules) instead of always falling back to the workspace default agent.

- [#15119](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15119) [`cbdb045`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/cbdb0459c84d28884ab3eb280c9611750090771b) - Redesign the Agent Manager New Worktree dialog. Pick the base branch next to the project, set an optional branch name next to the worktree name, and choose versions next to the Create button. The Advanced options section is gone. The base branch pick is kept as a draft until you create the worktree, and you can make it the project default from the branch picker. Branch pickers also open faster in repositories with many branches.

#### Patch Changes

- [#14866](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14866) [`e703b56`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/e703b5637b35f46a992fc79923468ec43e4488ed) - Reject internal agents when an agent starts an Agent Manager session for a named agent, and list the selectable agents on every rejection so a wrong name can be corrected without guessing.

- [#15118](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15118) [`33e6701`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/33e670164675d8e4a59b803bdafa68a75b0947d3) - Align brand yellow hover colors with Anaconda.

- [#15104](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15104) [`0f4936d`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/0f4936df112d1f4b6d1b319c8c9eb2fc55ed957c) - Keep Gemini thought signatures and other OpenRouter reasoning details that arrive late in a response, so later requests in the conversation replay them

- [#14942](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14942) [`b7672ae`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b7672ae502af111048191119d61cea62157291f5) - Show why a provider failed to load — such as rejected credentials or a network error — instead of silently hiding it from the provider list. The CLI, TUI, and VS Code model picker now surface the reason and offer to sign in again when credentials were rejected.

- [#15041](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15041) [`32bc724`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/32bc7248ea08066475b16c94d8b9864addcbd00f) Thanks [@hdcodedev](https://github.com/hdcodedev)! - Send review comments from the Changes view to the chat when the sidebar is showing History.

- [#14774](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14774) [`0913273`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/09132736d7905647679acd1f8d788aae36165e1a) Thanks [@LEN5010](https://github.com/LEN5010)! - Prevent restarted Agent Manager terminals from lingering after closing the terminal or reloading the panel.

- [#15113](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15113) [`ba0410f`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/ba0410fbdd54b5c787080cc73c38a6d5aadc9d44) - Update the VS Code extension brand yellow to #FFDD00.

- [#14925](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14925) [`4516a48`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/4516a48321acdd7a5ddd8437a5ae29a4b6e646ca) Thanks [@abdulhusainahk](https://github.com/abdulhusainahk)! - Show a dismissible hint naming the first workspace folder used by chat in multi-root windows, with guidance for worki

releases.title: v2.1.304
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin
- Added `decider: "person"` to a mod's `tool.check` answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked
- Added `e.isReadOnly` to a mod's `tool.check` event, set when the tool call is read-only
- Added `/auto-mode-setup`: a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your environment, now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude apps gateway and telemetry-disabled sessions
- Added `/claude-api managed-agents-secure`, which compares a Managed Agents agent's settings with Anthropic's published security guide, without changing anything
- Added the names of the tools called earlier to the compaction summary in the transcript view (Ctrl+O)
- Added a warning on Pro and Max plans when resuming an inactive conversation would use a noticeable share of your 5-hour usage limit: resume anyway, or start a new conversation and Claude can look up the previous one if you refer to it
- Fixed the organization policy not refreshing until the hourly check after approving an `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` at startup or switching "Use custom API key" in `/config`
- Fixed sandboxed commands failing to start on Linux when a `sandbox.filesystem.denyRead` glob contains brackets that are not a character class, such as a `[user-id]` route folder
- Fixed `rm -r` of a mounted drive or a folder at its top level (`/Volumes`, `/media`, WSL's `/mnt/c`) not getting the safety prompt that `rm -rf /Applications` gets
- Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` dropping messages from the saved transcript when the disk filled up while the file was being trimmed
- Fixed a plugin keeping a headless run going past `--max-turns`, Stop, or ended input by spawning subagents or re-running a finished one
- Fixed a failed mod reload removing the tools and commands of the version that stays loaded, and its messages being wrong or silent about whether the previous version is still loaded
- Fixed a click on a mod's button being lost when buttons with the same label and no `key` were redrawn unchanged
- Fixed mod sharing in the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill stopping at the secret scan on machines with managed settings and on Team and Enterprise plans
- Fixed scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes again for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give
- Fixed Write results and rejected edits showing a file outside the working directory as `../../…`; they now show `~/…` or the full path
- Fixed a claude.ai Directory plugin's skills not running as commands when picked from the "/" menu in Cowork cloud sessions
- Fixed Remote Control permanently withholding a desktop conversation's history when a different account was signed in to the terminal
- Fixed Remote Control failing to start from Claude Desktop when DISABLE_TELEMETRY or DO_NOT_TRACK is set on a paid plan
- Fixed model switches, messages and interrupts waiting behind a context usage check in SDK and desktop sessions
- Fixed `context_management: Extra inputs are not permitted` errors behind LLM gateways; Claude Code now resends the request without that field
- Fixed OpenTelemetry settings delivered through server-managed settings being ignored for the whole session after signing in during first-run setup or the first start after /logout
- Fixed unsandboxed Bash commands in Claude Desktop Code tab sessions on macOS and Linux not seeing environment variables exported in shell startup files such as ~/.zshrc
- Fixed the Consumer Terms notice being skipped for a day or longer after a server error
- Fixed `/privacy-settings` offering choices that may not apply to you after a network or server error
- Fixed a "Context limit reached" or "Prompt is too long" error after stopping a turn while Claude Code was compacting a co

## Highlights

The bundled CLI 0.23.0 includes two fixes requested in #11022:

- Managed memory availability now respects the `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` setting (#6941). Hosts that disable managed auto memory no longer see remember/dream requests admitted or managed-memory instructions in the system prompt; local patches can be removed.

releases.title: SDK v0.0.95
releases.body:
- OpenAI-compatible requests for GPT-6 models (`gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-6.1-sol`, `gpt-6-1-sol`, and later gpt-5 through gpt-9 ids) send `max_completion_tokens` instead of `max_tokens`, so OpenAI and Azure no longer reject them. Azure's `gpt-35-turbo` keeps `max_tokens`
- The hub daemon records which client started it (`CLINE_HUB_LAUNCHER_CLIENT`, `CLINE_HUB_LAUNCHER_VERSION`, `CLINE_HUB_LAUNCHER_TRANSPORT`) and publishes that as OTel resource attributes. SSH remote hubs report the local client with transport `ssh`. `@cline/shared` adds `withHubLauncherIdentity`, `claimHubLauncherIdentity` and `readHubLauncherIdentity`
- The telemetry self-check report includes `traces_exporter`
- Refreshed the model catalog (6,952 → 7,041 models). Adds the CommandCode and Reflection providers. The Cline recommended list leads with Claude Sonnet 5.5 again, so the `cline` provider's bundled default goes back to Claude Sonnet 5.5 from Gemini 4 Argon. Default models change for 302.AI (Gemini 4 Argon), Eden AI and Prime Inference (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave (Reflection Beam 1.0), NanoGPT, Pioneer (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), and Scaleway (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash). OpenCode Go keeps its `https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1` base URL, now pinned, because models.dev moved its provider-level URL to an OpenAI-only path

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/sdk/sdk/v0.0.94...sdk/sdk/v0.0.95

releases.title: v2.1.302
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL` to choose the model the client-side auto mode classifier uses; it does not change the model for server-side auto mode
- Added an `Idle compaction` row to `/config` for turning idle compaction off or back on; the notices shown after an idle compaction now say how to turn it off
- Added a notice to `/design-sync` and `/design-login` that standalone Claude Design (claude.ai/design) closes by December 14, 2026
- Fixed a "Prompt is too long" error when stopping a turn while the conversation was being compacted
- Fixed requests failing with "diagnostics: Extra inputs are not permitted" after switching to Vertex or Bedrock mid-session
- Fixed the Read tool loading an image file of any size, or a pipe or device named like an image, entirely into memory; image sources over 128 MB are now refused
- Fixed `/autocompact` and `/effort` saving to the wrong model when a gateway names Opus 4 or 4.1 with a prefix, such as `anthropic/claude-opus-4-1`
- Fixed a prompt cache miss when a tool added mid-session was loaded again through ToolSearch or after compaction
- Fixed `claude plugin` and other subcommands sometimes exiting before a queued settings or config write finished, which could lose the change or leave a `.tmp` file behind
- Fixed plugin marketplaces re-cloning on every refresh, and newly installed git plugins showing version "unknown", when git defaults to the reftable ref format
- Fixed the PowerShell tool not finding commands in a plugin's `bin/` folder, and reporting an error when a search that finds nothing (rg, grep, findstr, git grep) is piped into `Select-Object` or another formatting cmdlet
- Fixed Claude in the desktop app pointing you to claude.ai settings or `/mcp` to authorize or reconnect an MCP server where that option isn't available
- Fixed artifact publishes sometimes failing when Claude sent an empty list of edits, and Claude retrying an artifact update the wrong way after a newer version of the artifact turned it away
- Fixed `classifier_category` missing from OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events for most auto mode classifier blocks, and new `tool_decision` attributes pushing out `tool_use_id`, `tool_source` and `tool_parameters` when `OTEL_LOGRECORD_ATTRIBUTE_COUNT_LIMIT` is low
- Fixed rows in the agents view staying blank after moving down a long list or folding a section
- Fixed `claude remote-control --help` not printing its usage and exiting when not signed in
- Fixed `/design consent` and `/design revoke` suggesting `/design-login` when they fail in a cloud session, where it isn't available; the message now points to claude.ai/design/settings
- Fixed MCP servers showing no tools, or every tool call failing, when the server negotiates protocol version 2026-07-28 but omits `resultType`, `ttlMs` or `cacheScope`
- Fixed prompt suggestions spending usage credits on models your plan pays for only with credits: they are now skipped after a reply billed to credits
- Fixed URLs written in backticks being clickable only on their first row when they wrap; the whole URL is now one link in terminals that support hyperlinks
- Fixed `claude plugin details <name>@builtin` suggesting `claude plugin list`, which never shows built-in plugins, when the plugin isn't found; it now points to `/plugin`
- Fixed an emoji that a link starts inside wrapping one column too wide, which hid it in question previews and turned tables into lists
- Fixed worktree isolation refusing to create or resume worktrees under git 2.56 or later when a stray `.git` file points at a directory that doesn't exist
- Fixed a cloud session's cost and usage restarting from zero after the session resumed in a new process
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed git fetches failing with "bad object refs/heads" in sessions that reuse a checkout stored in git's reftable format

releases.title: SDK v0.0.94
releases.body:
- Plugins now run only in worker threads (the default, `CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=worker`) or in the subprocess sandbox (`sandbox`). The `in_process` mode is removed, along with its silent fallback. A host that ships no `plugin-sandbox-bootstrap.js` fails every plugin load with `PluginBootstrapMissingError`, which names `CLINE_PLUGIN_BOOTSTRAP_PATH`, instead of quietly running plugins inside the hub. The hub daemon's uncaught error handlers are fatal again. The SSH remote hub ships no bootstrap yet, so it reports plugin tools as missing
- Provider errors that arrive after a model stream has started are retried up to 3 times, and the final failure is reported as an error in logs and Langfuse traces. Exhausted retries no longer also trigger the agent's whole-turn retry, so retry budgets don't multiply
- Model request failure logs include the provider's request id
- `setHubDaemonLauncher` lets an embedding host start the hub daemon through a bundled Cline CLI, and `ensureDetachedHubServer` gains a `beforeSpawn` hook that runs only when a new daemon actually starts. The standalone SSH remote helper entrypoint is removed: SSH remotes run the hub through the uploaded Cline CLI
- `NodeHubClient` accepts `resolveConnectionHeaders`, so a remote proxy's WebSocket upgrade can be authenticated with HTTP headers refreshed on every reconnect. It is threaded through `HubRuntimeHost` and `RemoteRuntimeHost`
- `AskQuestionExecutor` may return text and image blocks, so attachments sent with an answer reach the model
- New `buildTelemetrySelfcheckReport` export in `@cline/shared`
- The `cline` provider's bundled default (the first Cline recommended model) is now Gemini 4 Argon instead of Claude Sonnet 5.5, because the recommended list now leads with it
- Refreshed the model catalog (6,862 → 6,952 models). Adds the Boundless and Standard Compute providers, and SambaNova now comes from the catalog with MiniMax M3 as its default. The Cline recommended list adds Gemini 4 Argon and drops Grok 4.7, and the Cline free list replaces Step 5 Preview with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL. OpenCode Go no longer lists MiniMax M2.7. Default models change for Cortecs, CrossModel, Eden AI, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Google Vertex AI, LLM Gateway, Ofox, OpenCode Go, and Prime Inference (Gemini 4 Argon), Fireworks AI, Nebius Token Factory, and Requesty (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave, DigitalOcean, NanoGPT, and Nvidia (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), Aixy and Neon (Claude Haiku 5.5), Agnes AI, Ambient, IteraCompute, Poe, Scaleway, and SenseNova

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/sdk/sdk/v0.0.93...sdk/sdk/v0.0.94

releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting
- Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the `claude-api` skill, including setting up trace destinations with the `ant` CLI
- Added the `%` motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y
- Added `rows` to a mod's `Input`: a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line
- Added `classifier_verdict` and `permission_mode` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, so auto mode classifier decisions can be told apart from permission rules
- Added `classifier_category` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, naming the built-in rule a classifier block matched, when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1`
- Fixed quitting removing a worktree made by a `WorktreeCreate` hook without asking when it may hold unpushed commits
- Fixed the `fable` (and `best`) model alias erroring on the Anthropic API when the newest Fable model is not available to your organization: Claude Code now retries once on the previous Fable model
- Fixed a misleading "Please run /login" error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed; the error now names the disk and says to delete files
- Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search program failed unexpectedly before returning any results; they now return an error saying the search failed
- Fixed workflow agents sometimes skipping their step, and the run still reporting success, after reading the harness note that their task text carries no user authority
- Fixed artifact updates being refused where a PreToolUse hook covers Edit or Write; Claude now edits the file and then republishes instead of changing it in the publish call
- Fixed skills and commands with very many or very long argument names stalling for seconds when invoked; only the first 64 names, each up to 64 characters, are now filled in
- Fixed skills, commands and hooks using very large amounts of memory when their arguments fill many placeholders
- Fixed stray characters such as `>0q` covering the folder trust prompt, and `>4m` before the shell prompt at exit, in terminals built on VTE older than 0.53 such as MATE Terminal on RHEL 8
- Fixed stray `GOK` text appearing in the prompt at startup in some versions of iTerm2
- Fixed switching to a model whose name contains `application-inference-profile` running your `awsAuthRefresh` command and delaying model-switch hooks when the provider is not Bedrock
- Fixed sign-in refresh timeouts and unexpected sign-outs after a short command such as `claude auth status` or `claude plugin list` exited in the middle of a token refresh
- Fixed a tool call cut off by a message sent mid-turn during its permission check being reported to the model as rejected by the user
- Fixed a case where switching to a model with a smaller context window could spend usage credits on a summary by the previous model without asking first
- Fixed conversations being compacted over and over, on a model you didn't pick, behind an LLM gateway whose responses name a different model than the one requested
- Fixed vim mode sometimes staying in INSERT after Escape on a slow or busy machine
- Fixed Esc discarding a typed AskUserQuestion answer in vim mode: the free-text field now supports vim NORMAL mode, and Esc cancels only from NORMAL
- Fixed the Read tool reading binary files such as .xlsm, .parquet, .epub and .heic as text
- Fixed a Markdown table with only a header row drawing nothing when too wide for the terminal, including in plans on the plan approval card
- Fixed the /claude-api skill saying CMEK external-key endpoints aren't available on Claude Platform on AWS
- Fixed skills no longer being listed to the model after using `/rewind`
- Fixed the compaction row in a resumed session offering ctrl+o for history that i

releases.body:
### New Features

- **Choose where `/share` uploads**: `sessionShareDestination` selects `auto`, `gist`, or `radius`. See [Sessions and context](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.3.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/settings.md#sessions-and-context) and [Export or share a session](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.3.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/sessions.md#export-or-share-a-session).
- **Cache-preserving thinking level changes on OpenAI GPT-6**: changing the thinking level mid-session with an API key keeps the prompt cache.
- **Kimi Code over Chat Completions**: tools added mid-conversation no longer invalidate the prompt cache. `models.json` base URL overrides must now include `/v1`. See [Providers](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.3.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/providers.md).
- **Clean model switching**: thinking from a previous model is dropped instead of being shown to the new model as text.
- **Resumed sessions keep their active tools**: `--tools +name`/`-name` applies on top of them. See [Tools](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.3.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/settings.md#tools).

### Added

- Changing the thinking level mid-session on OpenAI GPT-6 models (API key) now keeps the prompt cache ([#10853](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10853))
- Added the `sessionShareDestination` setting to choose automatic, GitHub gist, or Radius uploads for `/share` ([#10870](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10870) by [@vegarsti](https://github.com/vegarsti))

### Changed

- Changed the `kimi-coding` provider to use OpenAI Chat Completions at `https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1`, the protocol used by the official Kimi Code client. K3, K3-256K, and Kimi For Coding now accept tools added mid-conversation without invalidating the prompt cache. `models.json` overrides of the `kimi-coding` base URL must now include `/v1` ([#10720](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10720))
- Changed model switching to drop thinking blocks from earlier assistant messages produced by a different model, instead of sending them as plain text. The new model previously saw the old model's reasoning as part of its replies and could start writing its own reasoning into the visible answer ([#10995](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10995))

### Fixed

- Pinned internal Pi dependencies to exact release versions to prevent fresh installs from mixing incompatible packages ([#10865](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10865))
- Fixed resumed sessions dropping tools activated during the session. Resume now restores the session's active tools, with `--tools +name`/`-name` entries applied to them, unless `--tools` with tool names, `--no-tools`, or `--no-builtin-tools` selects tools explicitly ([#10785](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10785))
- Fixed stopping a codemode script or reaching its deadline waiting for a non-interruptible built-in to return on Bun ([#10748](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10748))
- Fixed repeated codemode timeouts or aborts accumulating surviving workers; admission now limits live workers to two across sessions, counting cancelled workers until actual exit ([#10748](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10748))
- Fixed `--model` choosing a provider by catalog order when several providers offer the match; Pi now prefers the provider with credentials and otherwise reports the ambiguity. `--models` and `enabledModels` add a model for each provider that offers it and warn about the ambiguity ([#10160](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10160))
- Fixed `read` line-range labels for numeric-string or null arguments in the TUI, session tree, HTML exports, and examples ([#9887](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/9887))
- Fixed the Nix flake build failing when a provider switched APIs: the model catalog pin is now refreshed from the newest published catalog when its model API groups differ, and releases pin the newest catalog an

### Added

- Show and edit agent models from the agents list.
- Configure transcript display, with a live preview and localized settings.
- Reuse the Core submenu in the prompt bar menu.
- Opt in to the Marketplace error handler.
- Fork a remote session from a message in the CLI.
- Let glob search an opt-in allowlist of ignored paths.
- Bundle Kilo CLI v7.8.12.

### Fixed

- Restore session lists after a CLI reconnect.
- Stop overriding the user permission config.
- Clear MCP sign-in state when the server is removed.
- Make the model reset forget the saved per-mode pick.
- Navigate to transcript parts from the session timeline, and jump to a step when its timeline bar is clicked.
- Auto-expand transcript blocks only while live.
- Recover a missed pending prompt from backend activity.
- Surface unreadable attachments as an inline chat notice.
- Use the primary brand yellow for logos.
- Keep RC builds on the production session database.
- Report why a provider failed to load instead of hiding it.
- Preserve custom agents and edit permissions during delegation.
- Stop automatic MCP OAuth reset and sync auth badges.
- Handle non-UTF-8 ripgrep matches in grep.
- Stop glob and grep include patterns from bypassing `.gitignore`.
- Track Windows background jobs and runner identity natively, and reject stale parent links when stopping them.
- Require explicit user intent before starting Agent Manager sessions or worktrees.
- Expose a reserved command-name clash as `/goal:command`.
- Point cloud sessions at a permitted temp directory.
- Resolve bare model names for task subagents.
- Surface terminal compaction failures.
- Limit Z.ai thinking defaults to built-in providers.
- Avoid false frontmatter errors when saving command files.
- Bound serve shutdown after signals.
- Send tool-result images as user content for Bedrock GPT-6 models.
- Reuse the loaded transcript when pruning large payloads.
- Clean up MCP servers when their startup is interrupted.
- Improve the missing-binary error message for Windows ARM64.
- Retry retryable connection resets through the normal backoff path.
- Start the backend in Windows drive-root workspaces.

### Changed

- Route gateway traffic via `KILO_AI_GATEWAY_URL`.

releases.title: v2.1.299
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS` environment variable: Claude gets the paths of `@` file mentions to read with its file tools, not the files' contents
- Added idle compaction in the terminal: a 200K+ token conversation left idle for about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires, so your next message doesn't reprocess it all
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS` to change idle compaction's 200K-token minimum; `"idleCompaction": false` in settings.json turns it off. Both need v2.1.290 or later
- Added `$.prompt.media` so a `prompt.submit` hook of a mod installed by managed settings can read the bytes of an image or document attached to the prompt
- Added `$.session.identity()` for mods installed by managed settings: how the session is signed in, and its organization and email when managed `forceLoginOrgUUID` lists that organization
- Added `size`, `weight`, `mono` and `tabular` to a mod's `Text` and named spacing steps (`xs` to `xl`) to its `Box`; `bold` is deprecated in favor of `weight`
- Added `--shutdown-drain-sec` to `claude self-hosted-runner orchestrator`: on SIGTERM it stops polling and gives the poll in flight and running spawn hooks up to that many seconds to finish
- Added the skill's frontmatter, source, plugin name and file path to what a mod's `skill.prompt` hook receives
- Added `/effort` and `/fast` in agent view to set what new sessions start with; a bare `/model`, `/effort` or `/fast` there now opens a picker
- Added a "safe mode" line to the agents view peek panel for background sessions started with `--safe-mode`
- Added a one-time note when plan mode won't ask before most edits or commands because bypass permissions is available
- Added `--disallow-tools` and a `disallowed_tools` case field to `claude plugin eval` to keep specific built-in tools, such as Agent, out of eval runs
- Added support for turning off the attribution block in Claude Desktop's Code tab: set `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0` in the `env` of a Claude apps gateway's `code` policy
- Added a field to the attribution block in Claude Code sessions behind a Claude apps gateway; remove the block with `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0`
- Added a `queue` door to the `session.append` mod hook, so a mod can make the transcript's queue records differ from the prompt as sent
- Added a note in `/plugin` and `claude plugin validate` naming a mod's hooks that are skipped where an organization manages Claude Code
- Added `/usage` warnings for max effort, workflows, always-on context and large tool results
- Fixed the error for a denied cloud session, which could point to the wrong organization when a key from `apiKeyHelper` was in use
- Fixed sessions on a gateway-specific model name behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` ending with "Prompt is too long · automatic compaction failed" near 200K tokens instead of sending the request
- Fixed a mod that submits a prompt at the end of every turn keeping a headless run going past `--max-turns`, `--max-budget-usd`, an interrupt, or the end of the host's conversation
- Fixed cloud sessions sometimes showing the model's follow-up text after a tool group's one-line label
- Fixed the Write and Edit tools creating a mod in a session's mods folder without asking in accept-edits mode when the config directory's path has no `.claude` in it
- Fixed installed mods that kept running in an open session after being turned off remotely; they now unload between turns
- Fixed Edit and Retry in Cowork and claude.ai cloud sessions failing on a message stopped while its `UserPromptSubmit` or mod `prompt.submit` hooks were still running (regression in 2.1.296)
- Fixed an agent teammate started without a description keeping part of a credential from its prompt in the task description shown for it
- Fixed the claude.ai view of a Remote Control or cloud session freezing when a large batch of events could not finish uploading over a slow connection
- Fixed a sandboxed shel

releases.title: Desktop v0.0.46
releases.body:
- A new outline along the left edge of the conversation lists each prompt you sent. Hover a mark to preview the prompt, and click it to jump there
- Plugins that fail to load or error during a session now show a status line in the chat naming the plugin and the error, instead of silently losing their tools
- You can cancel a Cline Cloud sign-in while it is waiting for the browser
- Session titles renamed on the web now update in the app
- The Cloud setup card stays visible on smaller windows when signed out
- Installing a skill without Git installed now says Git is required and how to fix it, instead of showing a raw clone error
- Scheduled routines: queued runs now start instead of staying pending forever, a run whose model call fails (for example, a retired model) is marked failed with the error, and after downtime only the latest missed occurrence runs instead of every one back to back. The routine editor now lists current models instead of retired ones
- With no model chosen, the Cline provider uses the first model in Cline's recommended list (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
- Turning reasoning off now works on every provider. Models that can't turn it off keep their default, and level-only Gemini models no longer reject the request with a thinking-budget error
- Screenshots and other images no longer inflate the token estimate, which made auto-compaction run long before the conversation was near its limit
- Auto-compaction uses the selected model's context window when the catalog entry has none
- Rule files that are symlinks now load
- Skills in `.claude/skills` are now discovered
- The editor tool no longer receives null in place of the text to replace from some models
- Refreshed the model catalog. Adds the AI/ML API, LowRouter, and Prime Inference providers. The v0 provider now offers only its default model, `v0-1.5-md`, and OpenCode Go uses its new `https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1` endpoint. The Cline free list adds Step 5 Preview. Default models change for 302.AI, CrossModel, Cortecs, DigitalOcean, NEAR AI Cloud, and Ofox (Claude Haiku 5.5), DevPass (LLM Gateway), LLM Gateway, and Meta (Muse Wonder 1.0), Aixy (GPT-6.1 Sol), CloudFerro Sherlock and Moark (GLM 5.3), Ambient, NanoGPT, Neuralwatt, and Novita AI

releases.body:

- With no model chosen, the Cline and OpenRouter providers now use Claude Sonnet 5.5. For Cline, that's the first model in Cline's recommended list.
- Selecting ai& shows its own API key and model picker, instead of the generic OpenAI-compatible form with base URL and custom headers.

Default models change for 302.AI, Cortecs, CrossModel, DevPass, DigitalOcean, Eden AI, GitHub Copilot, Google Vertex AI, LLM Gateway, Meta, Moark, NanoGPT, NEAR AI Cloud, Neuralwatt, Novita AI, Ofox, OpenCode Go, Requesty, Vivgrid, and a few others (most now Claude Haiku 5.5 or Muse Wonder 1.0). If you use one of those providers without pinning a model, expect a different default.

### Fixed

- Turning reasoning off no longer fails with a 400 error on GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Fable 5 or Claude Opus 5.5, and now works on every provider. Level-only Gemini models no longer reject the request with a thinking-budget error.
- An MCP server or hook that exits before reading all of its input no longer crashes the extension host about 3 seconds later.
- A 404 from a stale or retired model id is no longer shown as a sign-in problem. Cline shows the real error instead of the logged-out card.

releases.title: SDK v0.0.93
releases.body:
- Plugins load in-process through one registry per process instead of a node/bun subprocess, so the compiled CLI and its hub no longer need a runtime on PATH, and plugins can use the Bun global under the Bun-built hub. `CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=sandbox` keeps the subprocess sandbox. The registry wraps import, setup, hooks, tools and commands with timeouts and error capture, and tracks each plugin's state (loading/ready/degraded/failed/disabled) with its last error. A failing plugin no longer silently drops its tools: `session.create` accepts a `plugins` policy and returns `pluginIssues`, later failures reach affected sessions as status notices, the hub answers `plugins.list`/`plugins.status`/`plugins.reload` and broadcasts `plugin.status_changed`, and the daemon marks a plugin failed instead of shutting down when an uncaught error comes from it. Each session gets its own copy of every plugin module, so plugins that keep per-session state at module level keep working
- Turning reasoning off now works on every provider, not just a fixed list. Models whose catalog entry has no off option are sent nothing and keep their default, and models without a `reasoning` capability are skipped. Gemini and Vertex send exact `thinkingBudget` values only to models that advertise a budget; level-only Gemini models get a thinking level instead (they rejected `thinkingBudget`). A request never carries both the portable reasoning option and a native provider control (`effort`, `thinking`, `thinkingConfig`, …); the native one wins
- The `cline` provider's default model is the first entry of the Cline recommended-models list, falling back to `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5`. `CLINE_DEFAULT_MODEL_ID` moves from Claude Sonnet 5 to Claude Sonnet 5.5, and the `openrouter` provider default is now `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` too
- `estimateRequestInputTokens` and `createTokenEstimator` no longer bill base64 image payloads at the text rate. A ~90 KB screenshot counted as ~30k tokens, so a few images triggered auto compaction long before the transcript was near budget. Each image now adds a flat `ESTIMATED_TOKENS_PER_IMAGE` (1600). New `createImageAwareReplacer` export in `@cline/shared`
- Auto compaction uses the resolved model's context window. When the discovered catalog entry had no limit but the selected-model override did, compaction was handed the bare catalog entry and ran against the wrong budget
- Scheduled runs: queued runs are claimed correctly under `bun:sqlite`, which bound the store's named parameters as NULL so the desktop hub never claimed a queued run and it stayed pending with no error. Runs whose agent turn ends with a provider error (such as a retired model id) are now recorded as failed with the error message instead of succeeding silently, and the run report keeps usage and tool calls. Queued cron occurrences superseded by a newer occurrence of the same schedule are cancelled, so a backlog no longer replays every missed slot back to back
- Rule files that are symlinks are now loaded from config directories instead of skipped. Edits to a link's target are picked up on the next refresh or new session
- `resolveSkillsConfigSearchPaths` scans `.claude/skills`, so skills authored for Claude Code are visible to Cline
- The editor tool advertises `old_text` as a plain string. When the schema allowed null, some models sent null instead of the replacement text. Null is still accepted at runtime and treated as omitted
- Composio connectors: signed-in sessions register Composio's meta tools (search, manage connections, wait for connections, multi-execute), so the agent can find connector tools across toolkits, hand the user a Connect Link for an app that is not connected yet, and run what it found. Connector tools are discovered through meta search; saved desktop connection state no longer supplies model tools. Hosts can supply their own authentication through the new `connectorsRequest` option (`ConnectorsRequest` exported from `@cline/core`), which i

releases.body:
### New Features

- **Per-key OpenRouter model lists**: with an OpenRouter key, Pi lists only the models that key may use, with the key's context size, max output, and prices, including regional endpoints set in `models.json`. See [OpenRouter](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/providers.md#openrouter).
- **Published configuration schemas**: add `$schema` to `settings.json`, `models.json`, keybindings, and themes for editor validation and completion. See [Settings](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/settings.md), [Models](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/models.md), [Keybindings](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/keybindings.md), and [Themes](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/themes.md).
- **Clipboard copies over remote sessions**: `PI_CLIPBOARD_OSC52=1` sends copied text to a remote client's clipboard when Pi cannot detect the remote session, such as a multiplexer attached from another machine. See [Pi Process Configuration](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/environment-variables.md#pi-process-configuration).
- **Codemode improvements**: tool declarations show input constraints such as integer, minimum/maximum, and default, and codemode rows show elapsed and total time. See [Codemode](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/codemode.md).
- **`before_agent_start` for extension-triggered runs**: runs started by `pi.sendMessage(..., { triggerTurn: true })` go through the same setup as prompts. See [Events and concurrency](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/v1.2.0/packages/coding-agent/docs/extensions.md#events-and-concurrency).

### Breaking Changes

- Published generated configuration schemas for models, settings, keybindings, and themes at `https://pi.dev/schemas/*.schema.json`. The theme schema moved to `https://pi.dev/schemas/theme.schema.json`; themes loaded during startup now receive the same schema validation as later reloads. Update theme `$schema` references, define reusable colors under `vars`, and remove unsupported metadata ([#9880](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/9880), [#10751](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10751) by [@christianklotz](https://github.com/christianklotz))
- Changed `before_agent_start` to also fire for runs started by `pi.sendMessage(..., { triggerTurn: true })` while idle. `BeforeAgentStartEvent` is now a union on `messageType`: `"user"` events carry `prompt` and `images`, and `"custom"` events carry the starting `message` and no `prompt`. Messages returned by handlers are added to both kinds of run, and pending `deliverAs: "nextTurn"` messages are delivered with the custom-message run. Handlers that should act only on user prompts must check `event.messageType === "user"` ([#10267](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10267), [#5581](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/5581), [#10739](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10739) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai))
- Changed the session to count as busy while a run starts, including during `before_agent_start` handlers: `ctx.isIdle()` is false, `pi.sendMessage()` queues into the starting run instead of starting a second run that failed with "Agent is already processing", `pi.sendUserMessage()` requires `deliverAs`, and an abort requested meanwhile aborts the run once it starts ([#10739](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/pull/10739) by [@davidbrai](https://github.com/davidbrai))
- Changed `pi mcp list --json` to report `resources: true` for servers that offer resources instead of `resources` and `resourceTemplates` counts; Pi no longer lists resources when connecting ([#10526](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/10526))

### Added

- Added `reachesTools` to tool definitions, so tools that reach other

## What's changed

- Added a `code` key to the Claude apps gateway's `managed.policies[]`: the same settings as `cli`, also applied in Claude Desktop's Code tab; beside `desktop`, it turns on Claude Desktop's gateway mode
- Added `autoCompactWindow` to subagent frontmatter and `--agents` definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main conversation's window
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL` to run every workflow agent on one model while other subagents keep theirs
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer maximum delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request
- Added a note in `/plugin` on a plugin whose hooks are left out because another enabled plugin has the same name
- Added an `allow_large` option to the Read tool so Claude can read a text file past the usual size limits in one call when it needs the whole file and the context has room
- Fixed managed-settings `PreToolUse` hooks that deny a tool call with `"continue": false`, and managed `prompt` hooks that block one, refusing the call but not ending the turn
- Fixed PostToolUse hooks in managed settings not applying `updatedMCPToolOutput` in some sessions
- Fixed headless sessions starting a folder's `.mcp.json` or plugin MCP server that was switched off for that folder, after changing directory or reloading plugins
- Fixed a Claude apps gateway that serves `allowedProviders` with `"gateway"` locking out laptops that name that gateway in user settings
- Fixed a saved Claude apps gateway sign-in being ignored on machines whose managed settings set `forceLoginMethod` to `gateway` with no `forceLoginGatewayUrl` (regression in 2.1.295)
- Fixed `--teleport` opening an empty conversation when the session's history could not be read
- Fixed token counts for Haiku 5.5 and other models that take only adaptive thinking, which failed behind some gateways and were counted with budget thinking elsewhere
- Fixed resumed subagents being told that the user rejected a tool call that a session shutdown had interrupted
- Fixed hook output being altered when it contained text resembling a plugin hint tag
- Fixed secret redaction in shared transcripts and debug logs missing some values that follow a key with no value, including in JSON written inside a shell string
- Fixed a stray `52;c;…` escape sequence printed on screen after copying in older VTE-based terminals such as MATE Terminal
- Fixed toasts and notifications waiting unseen for as long as the `/diff` panel or dialog was open
- Fixed Esc or an interrupt during a `UserPromptSubmit` hook or a mod's `prompt.submit` hook ending headless sessions, clearing the typed prompt, or letting the unchecked prompt through
- Fixed SessionStart hooks of a plugin loaded after a headless session starts being skipped when a different plugin with the same name, or another spelling of it, had already run
- Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` printing misleading errors when registration is refused: it now names the org admin setting, or says a restarted on-demand runner needs a fresh work order
- Fixed a self-hosted runner session's git fetch, pull and push failing while another session of the same repository starts on a runner with `--capacity` above 1

- Fixed `$.agent.register` succeeding from a mod's hook that was still running after the mod was reloaded or removed; the call is now refused
- Fixed `$.http.fetch` in mods refusing a `HEAD` request when the response declares a `Content-Length` over the 4 MiB body limit
- Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add`, `marketplace update` and `plugin install` failing with an internal

releases.title: v2.1.295
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added `onFailure: "block"` for command and HTTP hooks: a hook that can't start, times out, or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through
- Added Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) support: terminals that implement it can show whether Claude Code is working, waiting on you, or done
- Added quoted text to the `/copy` picker, so a drafted message copies without its `>` markers
- Added a warning to `claude plugin install`, `enable`, `disable` and `marketplace add` when the settings file they write to does not load
- Added a line on stderr, when it is a terminal, that says what a `claude -p` run is waiting for when it stays open after its last turn
- Added support for `timeouts.upstream_ttfb_ms` on the Claude apps gateway's Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and other cloud upstreams: a value you set now limits how long a stream may take to start there, after which it fails over or gets a 502
- Added a "Backgrounding cancelled" message when you stop the turn while `←` is waiting for the current tool to finish
- Added an optional `models` list to every Claude apps gateway upstream: only the listed models are sent there, on failover too, and one `*` in an entry is a wildcard
- Added support for `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` and `forceLoginGatewayUrl` in your own user settings on machines with no managed settings, so `/login` opens on that Claude apps gateway
- Added advice to `claude plugin validate` when a plugin's README has no install line: it prints the line to paste and never changes the exit code, even with `--strict`
- Added `upstream_request_id` to the Claude apps gateway's `inference` audit event: the request ID from Amazon Bedrock, the Anthropic API or another upstream, for support cases
- Added `$.ui.notify` for mods: raises a native notification through your own notification setting and says which channel sent it
- Added children to a mod's `Button`: strings and `Text`, so a row of a list is one pressable with a chip or a dim detail inside
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_WAIT_MS` to limit how long unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) waits out 429 and 529 errors
- Added a `request-id` header to the Claude apps gateway's successful inference responses, so `request_id` in Claude Code telemetry matches the gateway's audit log
- Fixed every request failing on a `[1m]` model when a gateway, Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry refuses the context-1m beta; Claude Code now resends without it
- Fixed `claude -p` text output dropping earlier responses when background work started another turn; each turn's response now prints when the turn ends
- Fixed remote MCP servers in headless and SDK sessions staying disconnected after an outage longer than 15 seconds, or reconnecting in a tight loop to a server that drops each connection right after it connects; repeated drops now back off, up to 30s
- Fixed remote MCP connections being dropped when a server's error reply happened to contain a network error name
- Fixed MCP servers that repeat a pagination cursor being asked for the same page up to 20 times at every connect
- Fixed CSS, JavaScript and XML files returned by MCP tools being saved as .bin, which the Read tool refuses; font and icon files now get their own extension too
- Fixed Bash tool calls failing when the model passes `command_description` instead of `description`
- Fixed Claude in Chrome not applying a site deny rule written with port 80 (`host:80`) to plain `http://` pages on that host
- Fixed `/plugin`'s Errors tab removing a marketplace that failed to load, and uninstalling its plugins, on Enter without asking first
- Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add` reporting success for a marketplace whose name no plugin can be installed under; such an add is now refused
- Fixed `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS` moving a subagent to the background while an edit or shell command waited behind it, which started that call before the subagent finished
- Fixed PushNotification
